nodes.equation: min over side x E {lo, nom, hi} x G {lo, nom, hi} of sep_op (18 FE runs), mount and root at their nominal springs; D-93 pass lines: E_req = least tube E with sep_op >= sep_min on both quarters at G = G0, G_req = least G at E = E0 (log bisection to 0.2 %; 10 x the bracket end when the end itself fails)

nodes.title: Mount rocking stiffness estimate with the R5 cheeks (7.5 mm face_ahead)
nodes.equation: series springs: collar foundation k_f = (E / t_wall) d l_grip^3 / 12; nodding (about y) = two cheeks as deep beams over the free length a = x_meet - x_back (x_back = x_face + t_plate / cos c, x_meet = x_tube - sqrt(r_col^2 - y_cheek^2)): k = E 2 t h^3 / 12 / a, h = z_st + plate_hz - (L_tube/2 - ear_h/2); sway (about x) = plate + cheeks as a channel cantilevered from the lip-cap top to the motor axis: I = t_p (2 hy)^3 / 12 + 2 l_cheek t (y_cheek + t/2)^2, k = E I / (z_st - L_tube/2 - t_cap); k_axis = 1/(1/k_f + 1/k_body); k_est = min over the two axes; D-91: inboard cheek t_in, outboard cheek t over l_out = min(l_cheek, x_tube - slit/2 - gap_slit - x_back) (D-80), I = t_p (2 hy)^3/12 + l_out t (y_c + t/2)^2 + l t_in (y_c + t_in/2)^2, nodding E (t + t_in) h^3 / 12 / a; R4 for comparison: plate 5 mm aft, cheeks 5 mm shorter, symmetric 2.5 mm cheeks, 12 mm grip

nodes.title: Mount rocking stiffness needed for the separation rule, recommended design
nodes.equation: sweep k_rock over 500-30 000 N m/rad (k_twist fixed) on both quarters at nominal and low E/G; k_req = smallest k with sep_op >= sep_min at every larger k (log interpolation)

nodes.title: Mesh convergence, recommended design (both sides)
nodes.equation: first dominant station mode f1 (>= 50 % kinetic energy in the motor body) and sep_op at fin meshes 12x10, 24x20 (used), 36x30; change = max over sides of |f1(24x20)/f1(36x30) - 1| and |sep(24x20)/sep(36x30) - 1| (f2 reported only: near 360-600 Hz it swaps between coupled modes)

nodes.title: Gyroscopic whirl separation, recommended design (both sides)
nodes.equation: M q'' + Omega G q' + K q = 0 on 16 modes, G = -[Ip_spin e_shaft]x at the station, e_shaft = (-cos c, s sin c t_y, s sin c t_z) with the tangential cant c and both senses s = +/-1; sep over 1P/2P at hover and cruise and 1P at the cap, station whirl modes only; f_whirl_* = whirl frequencies of the first station mode at hover and cruise rpm (lowest over sides and senses)

nodes.title: Fin, tube, brace, collar, edge-strip bond and anchor strength, recommended design (both sides, LE fillet intact and cracked)
nodes.equation: FE static, limit cases L1 (C1 peak foot), L4 (side = max(mu F_corner, C5 side load), both senses), L5 (both senses), foot loads at the C1 ground point (x_te + foot_h, z_pad) through a rigid D5 shoe on the square tip; G2 (both senses, n_h m g at the tube end), H2c (T_lim along the 7 deg canted shaft at the prop centre + Q about the shaft, 4 sign combinations), H2s = H2c + B4 misbuilt swirl x (T_lim/T_hover)^exp as a line load at the B4 centre of pressure, both senses; G3 (lower quarter) set-down force at the motor body toward the wing; envelope over upper/lower quarter and LE fillet intact / cracked between the boss and the collar, and (R5, CR-C2-12) root fillet absent (root free, intact bucket at ultimate); section torque at the wing plane from the FE reactions (fin root + boss nodes, tube root spring, brace anchor) vs C1's wing-plane torque, equilibrium residual vs the applied torque; ultimate = sf x limit (joints x fit x prt); face MS = min(intact at ultimate, LE fillet cracked at limit (fail-safe)), face stress = Q_f (eps0 + z kappa); collar torque = jump of the tube torque across the collar band; strip-to-paper shear flow per face q = |dN|/2/ds + |V|/d (nodes inside the D5 shoe, x >= tip_clear_x, excluded), tau = q/w vs kd tau_board; strip end force per face = |N0|/2 + |M0|/d, the other strip of the pair N0/2 -/+ M0/d (signed, same case), pair sum |N0|; root fillet share (intact): -reactions at the pinned root nodes split at x_hinge, force and moment about each segment centroid, fillet / applied moment about the chord axis; pin force = q jf pitch; brace Pcr = pi^2 E w t^3 / (12 L^2); brace-end bond tau = F / (2 (w + t) engage); ear root s = 6 F (ear/2) / (w_ear h^2) + F / (w_ear h); collar bond tau = T / (2 pi r^2 h) + F / (pi d h), h_req at MS 0; anchor tau = F / (len_y pi d_spar / 4) vs peel x bond allowable

outputs.governing: edge: L4+ up_rf; face: L4- lo_rf; mroot: L5+ lo_rf; q_face: L4- lo_rf; strip_end: L4+ up_rf; t_collar: L4+ up_rf; t_root: L4+ up_rf; tube: L5+ lo_rf

nodes.title: Brace strip 10 x 2 against 10 x 3 (CR-C4-16), recommended design
nodes.equation: for t in (10 x 3, 10 x 2): sep_op (both quarters, nominal E/G); G2 brace force from the FE (limit, both quarters) x sf x fit vs Pcr = pi^2 E w t^3 / (12 L^2); mass of four braces = 4 rho w t L_mean; CR-B1-18 edge rounding of the 10 x 2 (both 2 mm edges full round, r = t/2): A and I_weak lose 2 (2 r^2 - pi r^2 / 2) and 2 (r (2r)^3 / 12 - pi r^4 / 8), Pcr scales with I; tape fairing = 4 x areal x perimeter (2 w + pi t) x 1.5 overlap x L_mean

nodes.title: Fin face with the D5 shoe cheeks extended (CR-C4-30), recommended design
nodes.equation: CALC-C4-D3-STATIC envelope re-run on a 36 x 30 fin mesh with the rigid D5 shoe region x >= tip_clear_x, |z| >= z0_prop instead of ASM-C4-SHOE-Z0; reports the face, strip and collar margins and the face stress with the cheeks as drawn on the same mesh

outputs.governing_prop: edge: L4+ up_rf; face: L4- up_rf; mroot: L5+ lo_rf; q_face: L4- up_cr; strip_end: L4+ up_rf; t_collar: L4+ up_rf; t_root: L4+ lo_rf; tube: L5+ lo_rf

nodes.title: Motor mount on the tube end with the 7 deg tangential cant
nodes.equation: t = (-z_st, y_fin)/|.| (motor-circle tangent); F = T (-cos c, sin c t_y, sin c t_z) at r = (x_prop - x_tube, 0, z_st - L_tube/2) from the tube end; side = T sin c; axial = T sin c |t_z|; twist about the tube = |r_x| T sin c |t_y| + Q sin c |t_z|; rocking = |r x F| in x-y (worst sign) + Q cos c; design = limit x sf x fit x prt; slip-clamp use = sqrt((F_ax,d / (T_slip / r))^2 + ((M_tw,d + M_C1,ult fit prt) / T_slip)^2) (C1's mount moment taken wholly about the tube: conservative); G3 set-down (CR-C1-24): axial push F_g3 on the lip cap, bearing on the tube-wall annulus s = F_g3 jf / (pi/4 (od^2 - id^2)); rocking F_g3 |x_motor - x_tube|, x_motor = x_face - l_motor/2; rocking envelope = max(H2c, G3)

nodes.title: Through-core block on D3's geometry (bosses not credited for strength)
nodes.equation: as CALC-C4-BLOCK with h = core depth at the tube (z_upper - z_lower at x_t): tube bore s = 6M/(d h^2) + F/(d h); shear-out tau = (1.5 M / h)/(e h), e = (W - d)/2; spar bore s = 6M/(d W^2) + F/(d W); web s = 6M/(W h^2), tau = M/(0.21 W h^2); bond torsion tau = 2 My sf fit prt/(pi d^2 W); R5 (D-68): the four vertical edges rounded R (r_e): the shear-out planes are tangent to the bore (|x - x_t| = d/2) and the rounds lie at |x - x_t| >= d/2 + wall - R, so they are untouched while R <= wall; the diagonal ligament bore -> rounded corner = |c| + R - d/2, c = (d/2 + wall - R, W/2 - R), against the least ligament min(wall, (W - d)/2)

nodes.title: Fins mass, recommended design (D3's CAD corrected to two layers, the 0.21 m half height and the brace strip as drawn)
nodes.equation: half-fin area A(hh) = integral over x_le..x_te of (z_top(x) - z_skin(x)), z_top linear from the collar top to hh, 2 upper + 2 lower; boards = (areal + adh) [lay_rec A(hh) - lay_b A(hh_b)]; braces = rho_cf w (t - t_b) sum of the four lengths (ear to anchor); (lay_b, hh_b, t_b) = CL-D3-MASS basis; total = CL-D3-MASS + boards + braces

nodes.title: Ultimate proof of one TEST-ARTICLE fin quarter (not a flight fin; CR-H1-17)
nodes.procedure: Test article built with flight processes but never flown: one LOWER quarter (it carries G3 and the longer free tube) = one 0.21 m half-fin cut from the flight board batch (two 4.8 mm layers laminated), CF 22 x 20 tube offcut 0.20 m, PETG through-core block (R 3 mm vertical edges) bonded on a 0.15 m spar offcut in a 0.15 m core offcut, plug, station collar as drawn (13 mm), CF 10 x 2 brace 0.16 m with anchor saddle on the same spar offcut, CF 10 x 1 edge strips x 2 with 2.5 mm CF pins at 15 mm, strip tails bonded in the collar tongue (D-70 inspection), R5 ASA mount (cheeks 17 mm) with a dummy motor (steel slug at the motor CG, M3 x 8 into the plate), D5 shoe AS DRAWN (legs 7 mm, 8 mm cheeks over both strip ends, CR-C4-36), LE fillet LEFT UNBONDED and the ROOT FILLET LEFT OFF (primary path only, CR-C2-12), 30 min epoxy as in BUILD. Steps, each held 30 s, loads at 1.5 x limit through a hand-held spring scale or hung weights: (1) L4 at the C1 ground point 59 N along + 37 N across (C5 3-D side load, D-65), both senses; (2) G2 79 N lateral at the tube end, both senses; (3) G3 35 N on the dummy can toward the wing. Pass: no crack, face wrinkle, strip lift, pin push-out or bond-line movement (witness lines on collar, strip ends, brace ends, anchor); foot deflection at 1.0 x L4 <= 1.2 x CL-C4-D3-FOOT-DEFL. Then load step (1) to failure and record the load and the failed part. If step (1) fails below 1.5 x, fit the extended cheeks (CR-C4-30, |z| 0.171 m) on a second article and repeat. Flight fins get a 1.0 x limit L4 hand check only.

nodes.title: Mount rocking stiffness on the bench
nodes.procedure: Mount with motor clamped on a 60 mm tube stub held in a vice; 0.5 kg over a pulley at the prop nut, sideways (y) and fore-aft (z); dial gauges at the motor can top and at the collar; theta = (d_can - d_collar) / spacing; k = F a / theta. Pass: k >= the CL-C4-D3-MOUNT-K-REQ value in both directions.

nodes.title: Tap test, as-built upper and lower quarter
nodes.procedure: Finished wing on foam blocks, props on; tap each motor bell in y and in z; FC raw IMU at 1 kHz (or a phone accelerometer taped to the can); FFT peaks vs 1P/2P at hover, cruise and the cap.

nodes.title: Three-point bend of the US-stock 22 x 20 tube (I1 buys, H1 runs)
nodes.procedure: Span 0.80 m on two 22 mm dowels, load at centre in 0.5 kg steps to 4 kg, dial gauge to 0.01 mm; E = F L^3 / (48 I delta) with I = 3.645e-9 m4. Pass band for the recommended design: E >= 70 GPa.

nodes.title: Torsion of the same tube
nodes.procedure: Clamp 0.40 m of tube in two printed V-blocks at one end, 0.30 m lever arm at the other, 0.5-2 kg, measure twist with a laser pointer on a wall 3 m away; G = T L / (J theta), J = 7.29e-9 m4.

nodes.title: Tap test of one fin quarter (tube + block + half-fin + motor + prop + brace)
nodes.procedure: Block clamped in a vice via a core offcut; tap the motor bell in y and x; phone accelerometer or FC raw IMU at 1 kHz; FFT peaks vs 1P/2P at hover, cruise, max.

nodes.title: Foam-board face coupon
nodes.procedure: Three 50 x 300 mm strips per layer count, four-point bend, span 250 mm, load to failure: face allowable and D. Weigh 0.1 m2 for the areal mass.

nodes.title: Block proof in a core offcut
nodes.procedure: Block bonded on a spar stub in a 0.15 m core offcut; 0.30 m tube in the bore; hang 18 kg at 0.17 m lever (30 N m > design 20.3 N m) for 1 min; no creak, no bond line crack.

nodes.title: Bifilar swing of one prop
nodes.procedure: Two 0.5 m threads at the blade tips; period of 20 swings; I = m g d^2 T^2 / (16 pi^2 L).

nodes.title: IIW fatigue recommendations: hot-spot stress
nodes.where: Hobbacher, IIW doc. XIII-2460-13, 2016, sec. 2.2.3: surface stress read at 0.4 t and 1.0 t from the discontinuity, sigma_hs = 1.67 s(0.4t) - 0.67 s(1.0t)
reasons: value never compared with the source (no 'checked' date)

nodes.title: Roache: grid convergence index
nodes.where: Roache, J. Fluids Eng. 116 (1994) 405; Fs = 1.25 for three grids
reasons: value never compared with the source (no 'checked' date)

nodes.title: SU2 v8.5.0 ELASTICITY solver
nodes.where: linear elasticity, hex8 full integration, MARKER_LOAD = traction x area, FEA_FILENAME materials
reasons: value never compared with the source (no 'checked' date)

nodes.title: Tube wall + LE fillet zone modulus 3 GPa
nodes.text: Isotropic 3 GPa (nu 0.35) for the zone between the square bar face and the board LE (tube wall + epoxy fillet)
nodes.basis: Stands in for the shell model's rigid LE link: 100x stiffer in shear than the paper faces over 5.7 mm, adds 0.6 % to the tube's out-of-plane EI

nodes.title: D5 shoe region modulus 50 GPa (rigid)
nodes.text: Shoe legs, cheeks, glue and the board inside them as one stiff isotropic block (50 GPa), as the shell model's rigid shoe
nodes.basis: Same idealisation as fin_fe rigid_fin. The two legs are joined by the sleeve floor on the step edge and by the back wall, so the board between them cannot shear or bend freely: the block is the closer of the two simple models. C4-R6 (CDR-01 e) tried the other one, legs only at the PETG modulus (1.5 GPa x 0.8 / 1.0 mm in the outer layers, board left as board, mesh_quarter shoe_mode 'petg'): without the sleeve tie the 7 mm legs peel off the faces and the face stress is 72 MPa limit on mesh level 1, which is not the load path of the part as built. A model with the sleeve as a 3-D body is not built; the rigid block stays the upper bound on the stress jump at the leg edge

nodes.title: Modal model: 7 mm of each shoe leg counted as rigid, as before D-106
nodes.text: In the station-mode model the rigid shoe block reaches 7 mm below the step (|z| 0.194), not the 30 mm of the legs as drawn; the leg mass is in the foot mass (CL-D5-MASS-FOOT)
nodes.basis: a rigid block over the full 30 mm legs stiffens the fin tip in a way two 0.8 mm PETG skins cannot (see ASM-C4-SHOE-Z0); the face-stress model keeps the full legs

nodes.title: Shoe free corner on the board rounded R 0.5 mm
nodes.text: The corner of each shoe leg / cheek outline that ends on the bare board is a 0.5 mm radius in the planform mesh
nodes.basis: CDR-ST-17: a 0.4 mm nozzle cannot print a sharper outside corner (D5 FEA uses R 0.4 for the same reason); with the epoxy squeeze-out the real corner is blunter. Resolved by about 2 elements on the finest mesh

nodes.title: Station-collar tail tongue modulus 1 GPa (PETG, 45 % fill)
nodes.text: Isotropic 1 GPa (nu 0.35) for the printed tail tongue that replaces the board in the notched LE-top corner, from the tube surface to 40 mm aft, strip band + 1 mm deep; the CF edge strips run on over it to the tube
nodes.basis: PETG about 2.0 GPa solid x P:fin_detail.station_collar.tongue_fill 0.45 (perimeters carry more): 1 GPa. The R4 shell model had the strips ending on a rigid LE link; the first 3-D pass ended them at the board LE and put 26 MPa into the paper faces at the LE (artefact, removed by this zone)

nodes.title: Hot-spot read distances 0.4 t and 1.0 t, t = laminate 9.6 mm
nodes.text: Face stress at the shoe edge = linear surface extrapolation from 0.4 t and 1.0 t (IIW type a), t = two-board laminate thickness
nodes.basis: the peak at a rigid-insert edge is singular and grows with mesh refinement; the hot-spot value converges and is the structural stress the faces carry

nodes.title: As-designed station masses: motor 84.2 g, ESC 7.6 g, bullets 4 g
nodes.text: A3-R6a roll-up items: PRP-001 motor with its four M3 screws 84.2 g (params 81 g), PRP-002 stripped ESC 7.6 g (params 6.6 g), HRN-E03 phase bullets and short leads 4 g at 0.8 z_st on the tube
nodes.basis: team/A3/mass_model.csv and subsystems/propulsion/parts.csv (2026-11-10)

nodes.title: Benchmark tip load 10 N on the 100 x 10 x 10 mm two-modulus cantilever
nodes.text: Solver benchmark only (not aircraft data): steel/aluminium halves, 10 N tip shear
nodes.basis: closed-form reference exists (Euler-Bernoulli + Timoshenko shear)

nodes.title: SU2 ELASTICITY cantilever benchmark, 3 meshes
nodes.equation: tip deflection, 10 N tip shear on a 100 x 10 x 10 mm cantilever, E 70/210 GPa halves; reference d = P (7 L^3/(24 E1 I) + L^3/(24 E2 I)) + P L/(k G A), k = 5/6; meshes 2/4/8 elements through the depth (aspect 1); Richardson on the three; hex8 in-house on the same meshes

nodes.title: SU2 ELASTICITY on the fin quarter: solver trials against the hex8 direct solve
nodes.equation: upper quarter, mesh level 1 (8 mm / 2 mm, 71 k DOF), D5 shoe as drawn, L4 side part; SU2 v8 linear solvers available in this build (no PaStiX): CG + ILU(1) and restarted FGMRES(200) + ILU(2), 1500 it each, tol 1e-9; converged when log10 residual <= -6; field difference max |u_hex - u_su2| / max |u_hex|

nodes.title: Fin face hot-spot stress at the D5 shoe, SU2, 3 meshes
nodes.equation: hex8 direct solve (identical to SU2 ELASTICITY, CALC-C4-SIM-CODES); L4 limit: F = (-F_corner, +/- max(mu F_corner, F_C5), 0) at the C1 ground point through the rigid shoe (least-norm tractions on its outer faces, exact force and moment); face stress = in-plane principal |sigma| at the outer-face element centroids (sigma = D B u); hot-spot = 1.67 s(0.4t) - 0.67 s(1.0t) below each shoe lower edge, max over x, both faces, both senses; ultimate = sf x limit; MS = s_face / s_ult - 1; meshes 8 mm global, 2/1/0.5 mm in the tip box; Richardson r 2

nodes.title: Station modes, 3-D solid quarters with A3 masses, 3 meshes
nodes.equation: hex8 laminate (faces, cores, strips, shoe), CF tube as an orthotropic square bar (E_z I = E I_tube, G_xz J_sq = G J_tube), rigid ties to the tube root (k_root springs), tube end, collar (brace spring k = 1/(L/EA + 1/k_anchor) at the ear); station rigid body (A3 motor 84.2 g) on the mount springs; consistent mass; eigsh shift-invert; station mode = KE share >= 0.10; meshes 8/5.7/4 mm (bar and link at half size), Richardson r sqrt 2; separation = min |f/f_forcing - 1| over 1P/2P hover/cruise and 1P max

nodes.title: 3-D gain of each station-mode lever on the governing quarter (CDR-19)
nodes.equation: first station mode of the lower quarter, hex8 model, mesh level 2 (5.7 mm), one change at a time; gain = f1(lever) / f1(base) - 1; separation with the lever = (1 + sep_3D) (1 + gain) - 1, sep_3D = CALC-C4-SIM-MODES sep_min (three meshes, extrapolated); gain needed = (1 + sep_req) / (1 + sep_3D) - 1

nodes.title: Pessimistic fin-tube axial modulus 78.6 GPa (RW 35046-S)
nodes.text: Axial modulus at the low end the design must pass with today, the GT-16 measurement being confirmation only
nodes.basis: C4-W2 section 4: the R5 GT-16 shell pass line, 87 % of the 90.2 GPa CLT page value (SRC-RW-35046S); the page values are CLT figures Rock West does not guarantee

nodes.title: Pessimistic fin-tube shear modulus 10.27 GPa (RW 35046-S)
nodes.text: Shear modulus at the low end the design must pass with today
nodes.basis: Half the page GXY 2 979 000 psi = 20.5 GPa (SRC-RW-35046S), C4.md wave 1 section 1.3

nodes.title: Station modes, 3-D, three meshes, pessimistic tube E / G
nodes.equation: as CALC-C4-SIM-MODES with the tube E, G replaced by E_k, G_k (both quarters, meshes 8/5.7/4 mm, Richardson r sqrt 2); separation = min |f/f_forcing - 1| over 1P/2P hover/cruise and 1P max

nodes.title: Station-mode separation from 1P/2P, 3-D, pessimistic tube (E 78.6 / G 10.27 GPa)
nodes.how: GT-16 (H1) bend and torsion of a delivered tube confirms E >= 78.6 and G >= 10.27 GPa; T-C4-TAP-D3.

nodes.title: Touchdown drift 0.3 m/s

nodes.title: Parked-stance factor 1.5

nodes.title: Gust factor 1.4 over the mean
nodes.text: Peak gust / 10-min mean wind at 2 m height at RFS in the morning

reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Lift coefficient lying flat 0.6
nodes.text: Largest lift coefficient of the wing lying flat on the ground, pod up, any wind direction

nodes.title: Tube-end cap 5 mm

nodes.text: Edits that put A3's D-47 item list back to the R4 bay: pack centroid at x_pack, trim kit POD-008 moved by dx_kit, pitot socket POD-006 by dx_nose. Value [x_pack m, dx_kit m, dx_nose m]
nodes.basis: D-47 (CR-A3-22, CR-A1-43): pack -0.001 -> -0.022, bay 21 mm forward, nose 15 mm forward. Used only for CL-C5-D47-CG-RISE; every flying case uses A3's items as listed

nodes.title: CG cases and static tip-over on the fin-tip feet
nodes.equation: CG from A3 items (feet replaced by D5's mass at x = c + foot/2) ; flying cases: pack slid until x_cg = D-62 target / forward / aft limit (P:cg.*), pack 546 / 550 / 590 g (D-64), and each pack at its D-62 flight station (P:pack_x_per_pack_m, D2-R6 / D-64) ; h = c + foot - x_cg ; narrow(+z) = atan((z_pad - z_cg) / h), narrow(-z) = atan((z_pad + z_cg) / h) ; wide = atan(y_fin / h) ; residual thrust T = lam W along the body: tip at acos(lam z/R) - atan(h/z), R = hypot(z, h) ; lam_max(err) = R cos(err + atan(h/z)) / z ; corner bound: x = forward limit, z = top of the z range ; D-47 rise = h(550 g station) - h(pre-D-47 bay, ASM-C5-PRE-D47) ; +5 mm allowance: worst station case with h + 5 mm
reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

nodes.title: Landing lean, drift allowance and parked-stance wind limits
nodes.equation: lean = atan(q S CD90 / (m g)), S = b c broadside or 4 fin_c fin_hh span-along-wind ; v_allow(phi) = sqrt(2 g (R - b_phi)(k^2 + R^2)) / b_phi, b_phi = z sin phi + h cos phi ; delta(v) = beta - phi(v_allow = v) ; beta_req = lean(5) + err + delta(v_td) ; V_tip = sqrt(2 m g z_arm / (h_cp rho S CD90)), h_cp = c/2 + foot ; V_slide = sqrt(2 mu m g / (rho S CD90)) ; V_park = min(V_tip, V_slide)/sqrt(SF) ; V_lift,flat = sqrt(2 m g / (rho S CL_flat))
reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

nodes.title: Static landing wind limit at the commanded landing heading (D-152)
nodes.equation: as CALC-C5-WIND v_land, with the lean (full broadside area S = b c at every azimuth, as the 6-DOF claim), the 10 deg error and the drift all toward azimuth az: narrow axis (lean + err)|cos az| + delta_n(v_td |cos az|) <= beta_n, pad line on the pod side (z_pad - z_cg) for |az| < 90 and the belly side (z_pad + z_cg) beyond ; wide axis the same with |sin az|, y_fin, Izz ; V by bisection. Q_WVANE_LAND -> headings 1: 180, 2: 180 / 0, 3: 90 / 270, 4: 0, else every 30 deg ; azimuths = heading and heading +/- herr ; limit = min over them ; pod face = az 0
reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

Previous: D-120 (CDR-14, board decision B9, stream S3 2026-11-13): MIXING_GAIN 0.5 -> 0.65 gives 16.25 deg of pure-pitch elevon, so the trim-at-the-stall forward limit moves from 0.04647 to CL-B3-V-CG-FWD 0.03932 (SM 9.2 %, stall there 12.01 m/s <= 12.3); aft CL-B3-V-CG-AFT-ENV 0.05133 (SM 5 % at 1.3 Vs, NP 0.06733); rounded inward to 0.1 mm; 12.3-16.0 % chord, 11.9 mm between the limits (was 4.8). The aft end 0.0514 was 0.07-0.12 mm aft of the claim (CL-B3-V-RANGE-AFT-IN, CL-A1-CG-RANGE-AFT negative): now 0.0513. First fixed-wing flights are flown at x <= 0.0465 m (SM >= 6.5 %, D-121); the marks are not scribed until T-B3-TWIN-NP. Before D-120: D-62 (B3 CR-B3-25, V1): forward CL-B3-V-CG-FWD 0.04660 (trim at the stall, CG height included), aft CL-B3-V-CG-AFT-ENV 0.05144 (SM 5 % at 1.3 Vs with the CG 18.5 mm above the chord plane), rounded inward to 0.1 mm; 14.6-16.1 % chord, 4.8 mm between the marks (>= 4). A3-R6a's 0.0522 m was 0.8 mm aft of this limit (SM 4.76 %), the predicted 0.0536 m 2.2 mm aft (SM 4.33 %): D-61 and D-62 move the CG about 3.3 mm forward. Was [0.0509, 0.0548] (D-60, B3 R4 at z = 0), [0.050, 0.0549] (D-47), [0.050, 0.055] (D-24), [0.040, 0.049] (R0). Written to mass_budget.json cg_x_m)

nodes.title: Tilt-board tip-over angles
nodes.procedure: Built aircraft, props off, pack in (then pack slid to the forward stop, then pack out), on a 0.6 x 0.8 m plywood board faced with the landing-mat rubber, a 6 mm stop strip behind the pads on the hinge side. Raise the far edge slowly with a phone inclinometer on the board; record the angle when the far pads lift. Four directions (+z pod side, -z, +y, -y), 3 times each. Pass: pod side >= 30 deg and within 1.5 deg of CL-C5-TIPOVER-R1 (else re-measure the CG z).

nodes.title: Touchdown drift and spool-down from logs
nodes.procedure: H2: 20 QLAND / QLOITER landings of the twin, then of the aircraft; from the dataflash log take the EKF ground speed at first contact (accel spike) and the time from contact to all motors at spin-min. Pass: 95th percentile ground speed <= 0.3 m/s; throttle out <= 0.71 hover within 0.5 s of contact.

nodes.title: Proposed mean cartridge plateau 37.5 N per foot (C5-R3)
nodes.text: Mean of the upper and lower cartridge plateau forces C5 asks D5 for (CR-C5-10 revised)
nodes.basis: highest mean plateau that keeps the level free drop at n <= 6 with a pre-crushed cartridge (4 x 37.5 / (2.6 x 9.807) = 5.88); needed because A3-R3's pitch inertia (0.0300 kg m2, was 0.0426) lets the second pad pair land harder

nodes.title: Pre-crushed cartridge: initial peak = plateau
nodes.text: Ratio of the initial crush peak to the plateau after a 2 mm press pre-crush of each cartridge
nodes.basis: pre-crushing closed-cell foam past its yield strain removes the initial peak (D5 models 1.10 uncrushed); 2 mm of the 42 mm usable crush in the 77 mm cartridge is spent, 40 mm left >= 38. T-D5-COUPON must show it
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Planar landing dynamics: level and pad pair first (pitch, roll), current and proposed foot; foot side load
nodes.equation: m Y'' = sum f_i - (1 - lam) m g ; I th'' = sum f_i x_i ; f_i = 2 x crusher(s_i), s_i = pad penetration (ramp to F_pk at eps_y L/2, plateau F_p, no rebound, stiff stop at s_av) ; pitch: Iyy, arms z_pad - z_cg and -(z_pad + z_cg) ; roll: Izz, arms +/- y_fin ; tilt scanned -err..+err in 1 deg steps, worst kept ; design = sink v with lift lam W, test = free drop ; current = D5 as delivered (stroke s_av, plateau F_up upper / F_lo lower, peak F_pk scaled the same) ; proposed = mean plateau F_prop, peak pk_prop F, bias upper (pod-side) x b_u, lower x (2 - b_u), b_u in 1.000..1.100 (0.005 steps) minimising the worst pitch stroke ; zero-level-moment bias 2 a_- / (a_+ + a_-) reported ; section z = F / (sigma sec_y) ; ultimate = sf_ult x upper plateau ; explicit Euler 40 us, governing case re-run at 10 us and at 0.25 deg tilt steps ; side load = mu_pad F_corner
reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

nodes.title: Single-foot drop rig
nodes.procedure: A foot (shoe bonded on a 2-layer foam-board offcut clamped vertical) under a 0.65 kg sled on two guide rods; free drop 0.115 m onto plywood; phone or logger accelerometer on the sled. 3 drops, new cartridge each. Pass: stroke <= 35 mm (model 26 mm), sled peak <= 6.0 g (100 Hz filter), no shoe-bond crack. With the biased, pre-crushed cartridges (CR-C5-10, R3) use a 0.69 kg sled for an upper-foot cartridge and 0.61 kg for a lower one (quarter gate mass x bias). Run before the aircraft drop; cheap and repeatable.

nodes.title: Aircraft drop (= T-C1-FOOT-DROP), proposed foot
nodes.procedure: Complete aircraft, props off, LiPo replaced by a sandbag of the weighed pack mass (ballast to 2.6 kg), FC on a small 2S pack logging IMU at >= 1 kHz. Quick-release hook over plywood. (1) Level, 0.115 m pad-to-floor, x2, new cartridges each: pass CG peak <= 6.0 g (100 Hz low-pass), every stroke <= 35 mm, each pair's stroke within 3 mm of the model (the R3 bias leaves the upper pair ~3 mm deeper by design). (2) Pitch 4 deg both ways and roll 8 deg, at 0.098 m (CL-C5-TEST-TILT-H): pass when each pair's stroke is within 3 mm of the model re-run at the measured height and tilt, and the wing TE stays clear except the wingtip corner cap. The model then carries the design case (1.5 m/s with 2/3 W lift). After every drop: shoe bonds, fin tips, tube block and pod bond checked.

nodes.title: Crush block ahead of the pack (5 m/s nose-in), D-150 drawn block section and step, D-64 packs
nodes.equation: per weighed pack mass m (546 / 551 / 590 g, D-64) at its station x_p (flight-card mark) and at the C5 trim to the D-62 target. Section (C5-W2, D-150): D2's drawn block section A_sec (CL-D2-BLOCK-SECTION, 52 mm wide) and over the fore-top step A_st (CL-D2-BLOCK-STEP-SECTION) for its length L_st ; drawn width bay_w - 2 fit, no lateral spread: A_L = A_sec - 2 fit h, h = (A_sec + groove w d) / bay_w ; A_L,st = A_st - 2 fit (h - step d). Length force F = min(n_pack m g, sigma A_L), F_st = min(n_pack m g, sigma A_L,st) ; KE = m v^2 / 2 ; eff = eps_d - eps_y / 2 ; block B length L_B = KE / (F eff) + L_st (1 - F_st / F) ; pack g n = min(n_pack m g, sigma A_sec) / (m g) (full 52 mm section, the upper force) ; nose wall inside face x_n = x_le + t_nose ; forward stop aft face x_s = x_n + L_A + t_stop (L_A = 1 mm bond line, no crush credit) ; gap_B needed = t_sp + L_B ; margin = (x_p - L_pack/2 - x_s) - gap_B needed ; most forward station x_fwd_max = x_p - margin ; drawn crush-stack station (D2, D-150 block blk_d2 = 31.0 mm) x_stack = x_s + blk_d2 + t_sp + L_pack/2, stack margin = x_stack - x_fwd_max ; A3's stack (information) x_stack_A3 = x_le + blk_min + L_pack/2 ; minimum cut length = max(blk_d2, worst L_B) ; extension = max(0, -worst margin) ; box x slack = box_x - 2 wall - (envelope_x + extension)
reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

nodes.title: Motor to mount: 4 x M3x8 into the motor base, incl. the 10 deg cant side load (D-164)
nodes.equation: P = T/(K d); head bearing = P / (pi/4 (dh^2 - dhole^2)); cant side moment M_s = T_lim sin(cant) arm sf (T_lim = C1's live CL-C1-T-LIMIT since D-161; was the 21.1 N requirement); screw tension F_t = ff (F/4 + (M + M_s)/s_min); separation RF = P / F_t; thread strip = 0.5 pi d e tau_Al with e = L_screw - plate (R3 canted plate, uniform grip)

nodes.title: M6 thin prop nut (ISO 4035, 3.2 mm, D-161) on the aluminium adapter post
nodes.equation: engaged length m = nut height if E1's thread margin past the nut >= 0, else nut + margin; preload P = T_nut / (K_low d); thrust through the nut (tractor, the prop pulls off the post) F = T_lim sf ff; post thread strip (aluminium, weaker than the A4 nut) = 0.5 pi d m tau_Al; RF = strip / (P + F)

nodes.title: X2814 V3 base holes 3.0 mm deep
nodes.text: Blind M3 hole depth in the motor base

nodes.text: Torque at which the dog fuse releases, carried by the 4 screws in shear

nodes.title: Motor-base M3 thread: pull-out and strip at the blind-hole engagement (X2814 V3)
nodes.equation: e = L - plate - washers; strip = 0.5 pi d e tau_Al (0.5 = thread-flank knock-down); axial per screw = P + ff (F/4 + (M + sf twist...)/s_min); RF_strip = strip / axial; shear per screw = fuse / (4 r), r = half pattern diagonal; interaction = axial/strip + shear/strip (linear, conservative: same capacity); RF = 1 / interaction

nodes.title: Motor screws on the 10 deg canted plate: engagement and head seating
nodes.equation: R3 (D3): whole plate canted, faces parallel to the motor face, holes drilled square to the face -> engagement = L - plate at every hole; for record, the R2 layout (flat plate, canted 2 mm pads) would give L - (2.5 + 2 + tan(cant) max|t . hole|) and allow a screw lean of only atan((d_hole - d)/4.5 mm) against the cant

nodes.title: Mount collar on the tube under the 10 deg cant side force
nodes.equation: side S = T_lim sin(cant) along t = x_hat x r_hat = (0, -z/r, y/r); tube torsion Mz = S z/r (x_tube - x_prop), x_prop = min(params copy, E1 CL-E1-CAD-HUB-X); T_lim = C1's live limit thrust CL-C1-T-LIMIT (D-161 E props; was the 21.1 N requirement); axial along the tube S y/r; design x sf ff pf; slip capacity Ts (torsion), Ts/(od/2) (axial, same friction)

nodes.title: Motor-mount slit collar: M3x16 + nyloc, rocking under the prop-nut torque
nodes.equation: protrusion = L - (2 ear + slit + nw wt); needed nyloc h + n p; clamp N = Ts/(mu pi r), bolt torque = K N d; rocking bearing p = 6 M/(od grip^2), M = Tprop sf ff pf; tube hoop = p r / t

nodes.title: Power frame PWR-006 on 4 x M3x18 PA66 into brass heat-set inserts (E-PWR-03)
nodes.equation: e = L - stack >= kmin d (D-41), e <= insert length, bore >= e + 0.5 mm; preload P = T/(K d); install von Mises = sqrt((P/As)^2 + 3 (16 share T/(pi d3^3))^2), As = pi/4 ((d2+d3)/2)^2; unplug design k = sf ff pf: tension per screw F_t = k F a/(2 s), shear V = k F; tension RF = s_pa As/(P + F_t); slip RF = 4 mu P / V (and at 50 % preload after nylon creep); if it slips the spacer bends as a guided column: M = (V/4) L_sp/2, sigma = M (OD/2)/I_tube; insert RF = pull-out / max(P + F_t, Fc ff pf)

nodes.title: Tube-in-block, block-on-spar and station-collar bonds
nodes.equation: tau = T / (2 pi r^2 L), T = T_ult ff pf; spar OD = tube OD (22 mm); tube bore L = core + 2 bosses; drawn collar: bond height less the D-81 dog notch, L_c,eff = L_c - (kw + 2 kc)(kd + kc) / (pi od) (closure round: the notch is cut through the ring to the tube, fins.py A_collar_tube); collar (CR-C4-23): T_lim = max(C1 J-FINHALF section torsion, C4 FE collar torsion); tau = T_lim sf ff pf / (2 pi r^2 h) + F_brace pf / (pi d h) (F_brace already x 1.5 x 1.15); h_req = (T/(2 pi r^2) + F/(pi d)) / tau; D-70 condition: 12 mm only at tau_c = 0.5 x 4.1 MPa coupon mean

nodes.title: Edge-strip anchorage in the station collar and strip-to-board shear flow
nodes.equation: C4 R3 FE (CR-C4-23): F = strip force per face at the collar end, design; anchor tau = F/(n w (tail - gap)); L_req = F/(2 w tau); tail net section sigma = F / A_net vs PETG in the layer plane (D-107: the collar is printed with the tail slots in the layer plane); paper face if unpinned: tau = q_lim sf ff pf / w vs kd tau_board; pins carry the whole shear flow: P = C4 pin force at the drawn pitch, shear P/(pi d^2/4), bending (pin loaded at the strip, reacted at the board mid-plane, bound) 32 P (n tb + t)/2 / (pi d^3); at another pitch P' = P pitch'/pitch; D-70 (drawn since D3-R5): d = d' = 2.5 mm at 15 mm; fallback d_alt 2 mm at pitch_alt; max pitch for the drawn d = pitch x RF(d), and for d_alt likewise; strip bearing P'/(d' t) vs CF bearing; strip net section at the pin F/((w - d') t) vs CF

nodes.title: Brace ends in their slots and the anchor saddle on the spar
nodes.equation: F_d = F (C4 R3, incl. 1.5 x 1.15) x pf; end bond tau = F_d / (2 (w+t) e); anchor saddle contact = len_y x (pi d_spar / 4) (90 deg wrap, C4 method), sigma = F_d / A vs peel

nodes.title: Through-core block in its core pocket with R 3 mm vertical edges (D-68)
nodes.equation: plan perimeter square 2 (Lx + w), rounded 2 (Lx + w) - 8 r + 2 pi r (wall bond area scales with it); a square-cut pocket leaves (sqrt 2 - 1) r of void on each corner diagonal; a pocket radius R_p seats the block with a corner gap (sqrt 2 - 1)(R_p - r) for R_p >= r (R_p < r rides on the corners), so r <= R_p <= r + bl/(sqrt 2 - 1); bead = nb x Lx of leg^2/2 section at gcc, two blocks

nodes.title: Bounding estimate: C4's frozen R4 fin joint loads scaled to C1's D-65 torsion
nodes.equation: k = C1 wing-plane half-fin torsion now / the C4 FE wing-plane torsion its R4 set was solved at (C4 checked them equal then, CL-C4-D3-SEC-T-VS-C1); the foot side load drives both the torsion and the strip couple, so strip force, pin force and the collar-tail demand scale with k (linear FE): F' = k F, RF' = RF / k, pitch_max' = pitch_max / k, L_req' = k L_req, tail net area needed = k A_net / RF_tail; H1 frame >= 1.25 F'. Estimate only, replaced by C4's re-run

nodes.title: Clocking dog under the mount collar (D-81): fuse torque bounds and hold
nodes.equation: Twist (C6, D-164): C4's CALC-C4-D3-MOUNT-CANT formula on C1's live loads, twist = |x_prop - x_tube| T sin c |t_y| + Q sin c |t_z|, t = (-z, y)/r, x design = sf fit prt, x_prop = min(params copy, E1 CL-E1-CAD-HUB-X at 10 deg / 14 mm); T_twist = max(C4 CL-C4-D3-MOUNT-TWIST, this). Dog (closure round): the dog is a printed ASA block hanging from the mount collar's lower face (layer plane, collar axis vertical), w_key tangential x radial = min(r_col, r_ring) - r_b, r_b = od/2 + gap, r_m = r_b + radial/2. Hold if the clamp is lost (lower bound): F = T_twist / r_m (C4 design twist at the current cant); root plane at the collar face carries tau = F / (w radial) and bending sigma = 6 F e / (radial w^2), e = station-collar gap + key_d / 2 (bearing centroid on the notch wall); layer-plane allowables tau_il = k_il s_y / sqrt 3, sigma_il = k_il s_y; RF_hold = 1 / (tau / tau_il + sigma / sigma_il). Was RF = k_il T_hi / T_twist (shear only at the notch top: missed the root bending). Bearing on the notch wall F / (key_d radial) vs the lower of the PETG and ASA in-plane allowables. w_key is the dog's arc length at r_m (annular-sector dog from D-164). Break upper bound T_hi = (s_y / sqrt 3) w radial r_m; fuse T_fuse = T_slip + T_hi (D-23); downstream capacities at the C4 bond allowable: station collar tau 2 pi r^2 L_c, tube in block tau 2 pi r^2 (core + 2 boss); RF_fuse = min(capacity) / T_fuse. *_prop = the same at the C6 proposal (joints.dog_w_prop_m / dog_d_prop_m) until D3 draws it

nodes.title: Tie cord splayed 30 deg outboard of the fin plane

nodes.title: Strap eye FIN-013 saddle-foot bond on the block boss and the tab in bending
nodes.equation: The eye sits on the outboard face of the boss (axis z); the tie hole axis is x and the aircraft stands with x vertical, so the pull is tangential to the boss. R = od/2 + gap + ring (bond radius); arm = R + foot + hole offset; A = 2 half R h; torque about the boss axis T = F arm; tau = T / (R A); design = limit x sf ff pf; RF_shear = tau_allow / tau; RF_peel-value = peel / tau (if the foot edge peels instead of shearing); splayed pull: tangential F cos(a) as above + radial F sin(a) / A in flat-wise tension, RF = 1 / (tau / tau_allow + sigma / peel); tab bending sigma = 6 F yh / (h t^2) in the layer plane (eye printed flat, hole axis vertical)

nodes.title: Clocking dog shear-out on a tube stub
nodes.procedure: Two D-91 mounts, each on a 60 mm tube stub with a 22 mm PETG station collar bonded under it (dog in the notch). Pinch bolt set to the T-D3-SLIP 2.5 N m. Load a 100 mm arm with a luggage scale until the mount turns; record the peak torque and whether the dog sheared. Pass: peak <= CL-C6-DOG-FUSE-T x 1.1 and the dog piece shears, not the collar bond (no witness-mark movement). Third specimen (clamp lost): pinch bolt backed off, hold the 10 deg design twist 0.69 N m (CALC-C6-DOG twist_used_nm) for 60 s, then to failure; pass: no crack at the dog root at 0.69 N m

nodes.title: Foot shoe and fin root bonds at the C6 allowables
nodes.equation: foot shoe (CR-D5-24): D5 now sizes at the C6 allowable kd tau_board, so RF = SF_D5; design load = kd tau A / SF; fin root RF = RF_D3 x (C6 XPS allowable / D3's 0.25 MPa) = RF_D3 kd; with leg l': x l'(n tb + l') / (l (n tb + l)) (fillet couple capacity, CALC-D3-ROOT)

nodes.title: Pod joint allowables owned by C6 (CR-C3-05) and C3's pod joints re-checked
nodes.equation: C6 design allowable = kd x typical; C3 pod bond uses sigma_a = ASM-D2-XPS-ALLOW <= C6 and tau_a = min(ASM-C3-XPS-SHEAR, ASM-D5-BOND-TAU) = C6, so RF = 1/R (conservative); tray flat RF = kd f_b / sigma; floor glue RF = kd tau_b / sigma, with a fillet the glue width t -> t + leg; hatch tab RF = HL tension / demand

nodes.title: Servo frame and control horn: minimum bond area into XPS
nodes.equation: F = Mh/arm (V_D/V_B2)^2 sf ff pf, V_D = requirements.vd_ms 27.2 m/s (D-50: VD held by the fixed-wing throttle cap; full deflection at VD is conservative vs F4's schedule, D-29); A_min = F / (kd sigma_XPS)

nodes.title: Foot piston snap hook: minimum finger length
nodes.equation: cantilever snap fit eps = 1.5 t y / L^2  ->  L_min = sqrt(1.5 t y / eps)

nodes.title: Epoxy lap shear on abraded PETG, ASA and CF
nodes.procedure: 5 single-lap coupons each: PETG-CF and ASA-CF tube offcut, 25 x 12.5 mm overlap, 120 grit + IPA, 30 min epoxy, 24 h cure (+ 4 h at 50 degC for the ASA set); hang water jugs on a luggage scale to failure. Allowable = mean x 0.5; pass >= 2.0 MPa (ASM-C4-BOND-SHEAR); >= 4.1 MPa mean releases the 12 mm collar (D-70)

nodes.title: Epoxy on paper-faced foam board, shear and flat-wise
nodes.procedure: 5 PETG tabs 20 x 20 mm bonded on a scuffed board face pulled in shear, 5 pulled flat-wise; record the failure mode (paper peels vs epoxy). Allowables = 0.5 x mean (replace ASM-D5-BOND-TAU x KD and ASM-C6-BOARD-FLAT-TYP x KD)

nodes.title: Flat-wise pull and shear of epoxy pucks on XPS
nodes.procedure: 10 printed pucks 30 mm dia bonded with microballoon epoxy on hot-wire-cut F-250 offcut: 5 pulled normal to the face, 5 pushed sideways; allowables = 0.5 x mean (replace ASM-D3-XPS-TENSILE and ASM-C6-XPS-SHEAR-TYP x KD)

nodes.title: Pod floor-to-wall corner under a strap pull
nodes.procedure: Two 100 mm long board U-sections (floor + two walls) glued edge-to-face as D2 builds the pod, one with the 6 mm fillets; pull a 20 mm strap off the floor with water jugs; pass >= 43 N (C3 per-strap design load: 85 N crash / 2 straps)

nodes.title: Heat-set insert pull-out
nodes.procedure: 3 inserts in 7 mm bosses printed on a 0.8 mm plate as POD-002 (same settings), plate bonded to a foam-board offcut; steel M3 screw + washer, pull to failure; pass >= 300 N each or, if the plate peels off the board first, record that load for D2 (unplug moment path, CR-C6-27)

nodes.title: PA66 M3x18 torque to failure in a brass insert
nodes.procedure: 5 PA66 M3x18 from the bought batch through a 12.5 mm nylon/PETG stack into an insert; hex key + luggage scale 50 mm out, raise slowly to failure; pass: mean failure torque >= 2 x 0.08 N m (>= 3.2 N on the scale). Repeat one at 0.08 N m, 48 h, re-check breakaway >= 0.04 N m (creep)

nodes.title: Motor screw creep on a hot printed plate
nodes.procedure: Printed ASA mount plate on an aluminium block with 4 x M3x8 at 0.20 N m, 2 h at 70 degC (oven), cool, breakaway torque >= 0.15 N m on all four

nodes.title: Motor screws on the 10 deg canted mount
nodes.procedure: First printed mount A, holes drilled square to the canted face to the motor's pattern; fit the motor; 4 x M3x8 at 0.20 N m; count turns from first bite (>= 6 = 3.0 mm, <= probed depth - 0.5) and check a 0.05 mm feeler does not enter under any head

nodes.title: Edge-strip pull-out from the collar tail
nodes.procedure: Print the 40 mm two-face station collar (ring + tail) alone; bond a 10 x 1 strip pair in it as built (board offcut as the tongue spacer); pull ONE strip along its axis on H1's lever frame with the ring held on a 22 mm mandrel; pass >= CL-C6-STRIP-ANCHOR-F (1456 N) with neither the bond nor the tail failing. Record the failure mode

nodes.title: Prop-nut torque on a finished mount
nodes.procedure: Bell held by hand, prop nut to 1.5 N m and off 10 times; collar witness line and lip cap unmoved

nodes.title: bay
nodes.equation: x_fs = pod LE + t + bond line + t_fs (forward stop aft face); nose to stop = x_fs - pod LE; bay L = x_as - x_fs; H = (base + H - t) - (base + t + floor stack); x_nose_in = pod LE + t; nose block = (x_fs - t_fs) - x_nose_in; centroid against the forward stop = x_fs + L_pack/2 ; nominal / heavy centroid = aft face - L_pack/2 ; spacer = x_as - aft face ; block B (nominal) = (aft_nom - L_pack - t_sp) - x_fs ; block section = bw (zh - top gap - tray top) - groove w x d ; over the fore-top step = bw (zh - top gap - step d - tray top) - groove w x max(groove d - step d, 0) ; aft reach = x_as - filler - L_pack/2 ; spacer = x_as - filler - aft face (D-174) ; travel = bay L - L_pack ; pack z = zp + foam spacer + H_pack/2 (E2 D-163; bay H stays pad top to hatch)

nodes.title: station
nodes.equation: most forward centroid that keeps block B = x_fs + t_sp + max(C5's L_B, A1's D-150 block 31.0 mm) + L_pack/2 ; station range = aft reach - that ; spacer sum >= range

nodes.title: fwd room
nodes.equation: forward trim room at the nominal station = nominal centroid - most forward centroid with block B

nodes.title: recess
nodes.equation: x0: upper surface z(x) = pod base; depth = z(x_end) - base, x_end = spar x - r - wall; foam under = base - lower surface z(x_end)

nodes.title: cad
nodes.equation: read-outs of pod.py#layout(): pad clearance, antenna A / B to pack, GPS to nearest power item, wire channel and crossing (F2)

nodes.title: pod bonds
nodes.equation: capacity = bonded area x epoxy-on-paper shear allowable

nodes.title: pack stations
nodes.equation: per pack m (546 g, 590 g acceptance line, 550 g): spacer = round_2mm(x_as - (x_target + L_pack/2)); x = x_as - spacer - L_pack/2; block B = (x - L_pack/2 - t_sp) - x_fs; block B min = CL-C5-BLOCK-L x m / 551 g (crush energy ~ m); x_as less the D-174 aft filler

nodes.title: stack
nodes.equation: pack on the crush stack: x = x_fs + L_B + t_sp + L_pack/2 ; gap to the aft stop = x_as - (x + L_pack/2) ; spacer that fits = floor(gap / step) x step ; play = gap - spacer ; same with C5's block

nodes.title: r6 geom
nodes.equation: read-outs of pod.py#layout() for the D-69 fixes: strut rib free length = bridge front - pad back; rib to skin = rib underside - max wing surface under it; bracket flange area per side; stop-T flange area under the floor; antenna B tube end x; D-74: pod bodies in the power-board keep-outs, outboard side room, pod bodies in the XT30U zones, XT30U exit clearance; D-150: hatch swing gap to the crush block, lowest tongue z

nodes.title: pdb pad
nodes.equation: flat-wise moment capacity of the ribbed PDB plate (rigid pad) = sigma x b x L^2 / 6 ; RF = capacity / unplug moment

nodes.title: straps
nodes.equation: capacity = n straps x installed loop capacity

nodes.title: pod crash
nodes.equation: F = (pod + avionics + power - nominal pack + acceptance-line pack) x n_crash x g
reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

nodes.title: ties
nodes.equation: capacity = n ties x tie rating

nodes.title: handle
nodes.equation: F_ult = gate mass x g x handling factor x ultimate factor

nodes.title: pitot
nodes.equation: boom length = socket inner end - tip x; exposed = pod LE - collar - tip x

nodes.title: mast bolt
nodes.equation: past the grip = screw length - grip ; C6 E-POD-06 min engagement 4.0 mm (PA66 nut fully on + 2 pitches)

nodes.title: mass
nodes.equation: pod mass = sum of the CAD part masses

nodes.title: Motor-mount slip clamp: the D-23 fuse
nodes.equation: side force at the can that turns the collar F = T / (x_tube - x_can_mid); root moment = F z_m (brace ignored: conservative); hold ratio = T / (M_mount,ult ff pf); bolt clamp N = T / (mu pi r)

nodes.title: Prop plane to the nearest structure behind it
nodes.equation: hub on the canted axis: x_prop = x_face - stack cos(cant) (D-51); gap = collar front - prop plane = face_ahead + stack cos(cant); required 0.14 D (B4 CR-B4-04). Tip over the tube (disc mid-plane, blade tip straight toward the wing, -z): x_tip = x_prop - sense tan(cant) (y_m / r_m) D/2; tip gap = (x_t - od/2) - x_tip (B4 CL-B4-GAP-TUBE does the same on its geometry)

nodes.title: Motor screw thread engagement on the canted plate (10 deg, X2814 blind holes, D-173)
nodes.equation: R3 canted plate (front and back faces both on the cant plane): engagement = L_screw - t_plate at every hole, less the washer stack under the head (D-173: 2 x 0.5 mm); tip clearance = blind hole depth - engagement; for comparison the R2 flat plate + canted pads would give L - (t + tan(cant) max|t.hole|)

nodes.title: Station collar height, tongue fit and two-face tail length
nodes.equation: R4 (D-48): collar ratio = h / h_req (C4-R3 envelope torsion + brace shear) and h / h_req_c6 (C6, max of C1 and C4 torsion + brace shear); tongue fit = h - (w / cos e + tongue depth), e = top-edge slope from the collar top (L/2 - grip - gap) at the LE (x_t + od/2 + gap) to the half height at the step front (te - sq); strip embedment = tail - LE gap, ratio = embedment / embed_req (C6, two faces bonded: tongue + wall)
reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

nodes.title: Strap eye on the block boss (H1 restrained run)
nodes.equation: worst ligament e = min(L - yh - d/2, (h - d)/2); shear-out capacity 2 e t tau; RF = capacity / (F sf pf)

nodes.title: Stepped foot tip for D5's shoe
nodes.equation: R4 (D-54): square-tip ratio = D3 tip length / D5 step length (te - x_step D5); step mismatch = max(|x_sq - x_d5|, |z_step - z_d5|); tip edge width = n t_board

nodes.title: ESC pad inside the hover slipstream
nodes.equation: pad radial extent from the motor axis r = |z_m - z_pad| -/+ h/2 inside [hub R, wash R]

nodes.title: Half-fin root fillet joint, foot side load
nodes.equation: R5 (D-65): M = share S_side,ult pf h with the design foot side load (C1 max of friction and C5's 3-D sim, ultimate; was mu F_foot). R4 fillet zones (fins.py): full leg over the last L_eff of BONDED root from the TE, leg_aft aft of the hinge x_h = c (1 - ef), the lower root skips the link slot x_h +/- slot (CR-D6-04). M_cap = sigma_xps sum(leg_i (t_fin + leg_i) L_i); governing = the root whose full zone carries the least; rf_allow = rf kd (C6 allowable, CR-C6-24)

nodes.title: Brace geometry, D3 R3
nodes.equation: ear point (x_t, y_f - r_collar - ear/2, z_ear_mid = L_tube/2 - grip - gap - ear_h/2), anchor (x_s, y_a, z_skin + proud/2); Pcr = pi^2 E (w t^3/12) / L^2 (pinned, thin axis); Pcr ratio = Pcr / F_design (C4); lateral axial stiffness ky = E w t (dy/L)^2 / L (information). R3: no longer reads C4's R1 strut (CR-C4-26)
reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

nodes.title: Cartridge crush coupon, both types
nodes.procedure: Pre-crush every segment 1 mm (drill-press stop). Crush 3 type-U and 3 type-L cartridge pairs in a printed piston + shoe on the drill press over the H1 load cell, 45 mm at < 10 mm/s; record force every 2 mm. Pass (C5-R3, mean force 5-40 mm): U 38.2-40.2 N, L 34.6-36.3 N, ratio U/L 1.09-1.14, peak <= 1.05 x plateau, flat to 45 mm (R9: 43 mm stroke). Off target: change section_y_m (both types) by the force ratio, or the bore tube (ratio), and re-run feet_calc.py.

nodes.title: Pad slide on an incline (the landing mat)
nodes.procedure: Foot with the faced pad, 0.65 kg on it, on a board covered with the landing mat the team flies from; raise the board until the foot slides; mu = tan(angle); 5 repeats, dry, and 5 with the mat damp. Pass (D-105): every slide at or below 21.8 deg (mu <= 0.40). Fail: change the face material, or adopt the sideways piston snap (23-26 N release, CDR decision B1 fallback).

nodes.title: Timed foot-insert swap
nodes.procedure: One student, field kit only, swap a crushed insert for a spare on the built aircraft; pass <= 10 min.

nodes.title: Shoe bond and flange proof load
nodes.procedure: Shoe bonded (24 h) on a stepped two-layer foam-board offcut with strip ends; load the pad along x to 96 N (C1 upper-foot ult 66.6 N x 1.4375) through a 10 mm steel block at the pad edge; hold 3 s. Pass: no bond crack, no flange crack.

nodes.title: Side load at the pad: proof of every flight shoe, failure load of one per batch
nodes.procedure: Shoes printed as flown (standing, layers stacked along the sleeve axis). Step 1, every flight shoe before it is bonded: seat it on a stepped two-layer board offcut clamped in a vice (legs taped, not glued), insert pushed 5 mm in; hang CL-D5-SIDE-PROOF-EACH (1.15 x limit, 28.2 N at the D-105 cap) at the pad sideways along +y, then +z, 3 s each; pass: no crack or whitening at the rim, window or roof, insert still slides. Step 2, one extra shoe per printed batch, bonded on an offcut (as T-D5-PROOF): load the pad sideways in 5 N steps to failure, +y; pass: failure at or above CL-D5-SIDE-BATCH-FAIL (1.5 x 1.25 x limit, 45.9 N); record the load and where it cracks. A batch that fails step 2 is not flown. Then C5's T-C5-SHOE-SIDE-FAIL (+z) on a second sample of the first batch.

nodes.title: Servo-to-elevon four-bar: throw, ratio, torque factor
nodes.equation: |P(theta) - Q(delta)| = L0; k(theta) = d delta / d theta; worst servo torque / H25 = max over travel of (delta/25) k

nodes.title: Servo torque required at the output vs rating
nodes.equation: T = SF x H x torque_factor (four-bar, worst point); kgf cm = N m / g x 100

nodes.title: Pushrod force, buckling and horn bond area
nodes.equation: F = H / (r_h sin phi) worst; Pcr = pi^2 E I / L^2; A_min = F sf ff pf / (kd sigma_XPS); horn bond area = lower flange + the two slot walls (the D-89c backplate MEC-013 is a separate part and is not counted); moment check tau = F_design r_h / (A r_c), r_c = area-weighted distance of the bond from the hinge axis; U-slot on the torque tube alone: T_cap = tau_bond (pi d / 2) t_plate d / 2

nodes.title: Clearances through the full mechanical travel
nodes.equation: min over delta in [-stop, stop] of the gaps: bridge rod to fin notch sides, bottom and the fixed-core skin; horn arm to the core lower skin; pushrod to the lower skin; clevis to the boss; horn plate to the clevis slot bottom

nodes.title: Surface free play, worst-case sum
nodes.equation: slop = backlash x k_neutral + (play_arm + play_horn) / r_h (rad -> deg)

nodes.title: Inter-panel rod lag, panel twist and elevon effectiveness loss
nodes.equation: rod: fixed-guided beam, d = F L^3 / (12 E I), F = H_out / r_b, lag = d / r_b; panel: uniform torque m from the drive point, tube over the first a L (GJ_h), skin + foam beyond (GJ_l): tip = m L^2 [(a - a^2/2)/GJ_h + (1-a)^2/(2 GJ_l)], mean = m L^2 [(a^2/2 - a^3/6 + (a - a^2/2)(1-a))/GJ_h + (1-a)^3/(3 GJ_l)] (a = 1: tip m L^2/2GJ, mean 2/3 tip); GJ = G_tube J_tube + 4 A^2 G_skin t / s (closed tape box) + G_xps c_e t^3 / 12; loss = mean lag / 25 deg

nodes.title: Bridge-rod choice: outboard effectiveness loss and mass per rod
nodes.equation: lag_alt = lag x (E d^4) / (E_alt d_alt^4) (same fixed-guided beam); loss_alt = loss + (lag_alt - lag) / 25 deg; m = pi d^2 / 4 x L_cut x rho

nodes.title: Servo frame bonded area and the area its load needs
nodes.equation: A = rim (Lx Ly - (Lx - 2r)(Ly - 2r)) + inboard wall Lx Hz + 2 end walls Ly Hz; Lx = ear span + 2 w, Ly = H + boss + t_arm + c + w (1.5 mm arm gap left out: conservative), Hz = W + c + w; F = T_stall / r_arm + T_stall / Lx; A_min = F sf ff pf / (kd sigma_XPS) (C6 method)

nodes.title: Servo throw, ratio and stops
nodes.procedure: Wing on the bench, servo on the 6 V rail: set SERVOn_MIN/MAX for +/-25 deg (protractor on the TE), read the arm angle, then drive to the 30 deg stops by hand: feeler gauge >= 1 mm at the notch, horn and pushrod

nodes.title: Surface free play
nodes.procedure: Servo powered at neutral; push the TE up and down with 0.5 N; dial gauge at the TE; play / elevon chord -> deg; <= 1.0 deg per panel

nodes.title: Panel twist and lag under load
nodes.procedure: Servo at +25 deg; hang the VA hinge moment share as weights at the far-end TE of each panel; protractor at both ends; mean lag <= 2.5 deg (10 %)

nodes.title: Weigh the mechanisms parts

nodes.title: Packs travel outside the box
nodes.text: Flight packs ride in a LiPo bag (E2), not in the box; the aircraft in the box is the gate mass less one pack
nodes.basis: LiPo transport practice (E2 owns); keeps the loaded box under 6 kg

nodes.title: Design drop is flat on the floor
nodes.text: The 0.3 m sill drop is designed for a flat floor impact; side, end and corner impacts are checked by test only
nodes.basis: a box slipping off a sill lands on its floor or a bottom edge; edge drops rotate the box and load less (ISTA practice)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Lid pillars stop the rebound before the upper tube ends reach the lid
nodes.text: After the floor drop the aircraft rebounds into the two PE hold-down pillars; they arrest it before the upper tube ends and foot pads close the 10 mm static gap to the bare lid shell, so the lid needs no lining
nodes.basis: EST: rebound at e = 0.5 from 2.43 m/s gives ~1.1 J on 2.05 kg; two 100 x 60 mm PE pillars ~0.23 m tall at ~40 kPa over 15 mm (5 preload + 10 gap) store ~3.6 J (3x). T-D7-BOX-DROP checks it: chalk on the upper motor caps, no mark on the lid
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Cradle crush column: stroke, load factor, free travel
nodes.equation: s_use = eps_use t ; n_T = 1 + h / (eta s_use) ; s_bottom = eps_bottom t ; travel_req = s_bottom + margin ; t_req = h / (eta (n_allow - 1) eps_use)

nodes.title: Box stack-up: height needed, clearances, drop allowed by the 0.50 m box
nodes.equation: floor = shell + doubler ; lid = shell + lining ; H_req = floor + travel_req + env_z + gap_min + lid ; travel = H - floor - lid - env_z - gap_min ; clear_bottoming = travel - s_bottom ; nose_gap = W - 2 shell - env_x - aft_gap - nose_pad (- nose_ext) ; x_clear = min(nose_gap_ext, aft_gap) ; tip_to_pad = (L - 2 shell - env_y) / 2 - pad ; antenna_gap = nose_gap_ext - antenna_ext ; D-150 (D7-W3): env_x = chord + foot_h - pod.x_le (drawn, as fusion/transport.py places the box) ; collar_gap = nose_gap_ext - collar ; ant_drawn_gap = x_ant_b - x_pad ; env_cover = env_x_param - env_x ; A1 box: t_max = (travel_A1 - margin) / eps_bottom, h_allow = (n_allow - 1) eta eps_use t_max ; closure 2026-11-14: t_req = h / (eta (n_allow - 1) eps_use) ; H_min = floor + eps_bottom t_req + margin + env_z + gap_min + lid ; H_floor = floor + env_z + lid

reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

nodes.title: Field set-up time, closed box to the arm check
nodes.equation: T = sum(step seconds) / 60

steps: open box: pull the tails of the 2 cord lashings (slipped hitch), lift lid (pillars come with it); unfold the mat upwind, rubber up
lift aircraft by the centre section, stand it on its four feet on the mat; glance at the four replace-mark grooves
take props, pitot boom and pouch from the tray
fit 4 props, colour-matched to the motor (LH nut on the CW motors), 10 mm spanner
plug in the pitot boom, check the tubes, tip cover off
TX on (before the pack, flight card)
take a pack from the battery can, seat it at the trim mark, strap it
close the AS150U pack plug, FC boots

nodes.title: Crush-column coupon test
nodes.procedure: Two 60 x 50 x 120 mm PE columns under a 2.05 kg dummy on a saddle; drop 0.3 m onto concrete, phone accelerometer on the dummy (>= 400 Hz app); 1.7 and 2.2 pcf; pick the lower peak

nodes.title: Loaded box drop
nodes.procedure: Ballasted spar-and-tube dummy with real feet first, then the aircraft. 0.3 m flat drop and one bottom-edge drop; then the off-axis faces at their CL-D7-*-DROP-ALLOW heights (end, front, aft, lid-down), dummy only; accelerometer taped on the spar at y 0; chalk on the motor caps, foot pads, pod nose and wingtips (no mark on floor, lid or walls except the pads)

nodes.title: Weigh the box empty and loaded, the mat, the battery can and the tote
nodes.procedure: 10 kg luggage scale, 3 readings each

nodes.title: Hand-hole pull test
nodes.procedure: Loaded box hung from each hand hole in turn for 1 min, then jerked 3 times from 50 mm slack; no crease, tear or crushed flutes at the hole edge

nodes.title: Timed field set-up
nodes.procedure: CHECKLIST.md read aloud by one person, stopwatch by a second; three field days

The calcs read the params key; the limiter acts on the power module's reading, so the model takes the sensor as exact and the sensor error is carried by ASM-E1-SENSOR-TOL
nodes.basis: D-148 (review/DESIGN-ROUND-2026-11-14/A1.md): 100 -> 70 A so the winding stays <= 25 A on the first motor bound with the 11x5.5MR; the 93 A second-bound value is withdrawn in rev 10 (ASM-E1-ILIM-B2). Rev 9 (wave 2): was a fixed 100 A in this assumption

nodes.basis: D-148 condition (A1.md): the 70 A value sits in the first-bound pass window only with this calibration; uncalibrated the planning error is +/-5 % (ASM-F1-SENSOR-TOL). D-157 (E1 wave 2): at 9 deg the first-bound window is 69.37-71.07 A, so the limiter is 70.2 A with +/-1.1 % (D-148's +/-1.5 % at 70 A failed the T/W 2.0 edge)

nodes.basis: E1 wave 1 (review/DESIGN-ROUND-2026-11-14/E1.md 1.4): second-bound pass window 91.5-94.8 A at 7 deg; A1 D-148 carries 93 A as the alternative. Information case only (CALC-E1-ILIM-COND)

nodes.title: Fallback cruise speed 17 m/s (D-96 c, CDR decision B6)
nodes.text: AIRSPEED_MIN = AIRSPEED_CRUISE = 17 m/s: the planning case while the tripped stall (12.85 m/s) is the baseline, until T-B2-STALL
nodes.basis: params/CHANGE-LOG.md D-96 (c): 17 holds to a 13.07 m/s stall; review/CDR-2026-11-13/CDR-SUMMARY.md decision B6 makes it the planning baseline. Since D-145 (2026-11-14) performance.cruise_ms is 17 too, so CALC-E1-CRUISE and CALC-E1-CRUISE-V17 give the same point (ratio_to_cruise 1.0); the id is kept because E2 and B1 read CL-E1-CRUISE-P-55-V17

nodes.title: Second bound (rejected reading since rev 10, information only): the maker's top row is a true 14.8 V full-throttle point
nodes.text: the maker's 30 A row (7 500 rpm, 1 580 gf, 11x4.7, 94 degC) was taken at 14.8 V at the ESC and 100 % duty. The station then has an effective series resistance R_eff = (14.8 - w / Kv) / I_m at that row (winding at its 94 degC, ESC and everything the simple model leaves out), used unchanged at other bus voltages and with the 11x5.5MR
nodes.basis: CDR-AE-01 (review/CDR-2026-11-13/CDR-aero.md): the 'sagging supply' reading of the rows above 12 A has no evidence, so the rows are a second bound, not discarded data. A fixed series resistance is the simplest model that reproduces the row; the reviewer's cruder rule (full-throttle rpm proportional to bus voltage) is carried beside it as a sensitivity. T-E1-STAND with a logged bus voltage decides between the bounds. REJECTED in the closure round (2026-11-14, rev 10) by the maker's own published rows (CALC-E1-BOUND2-CHECK): (1) applied at the maker's 11.1 V full-throttle row with the same 11x4.7 it predicts CL-E1-B2-MISS-111 less thrust than the maker measured; (2) the five full-throttle rows, read as held-voltage points, need five different station resistances (CL-E1-R-UB-SPREAD), which no fixed station has; (3) it puts CL-E1-RM-NEEDED-B2 times the maker-stated winding resistance in the motor, and even the least pessimistic held-voltage reading needs CL-E1-RM-NEEDED-MIN times. The volts column is the 4S / 3S nominal rating, so the rows do not fix the voltage at the ESC; the resistance outside the motor belongs to the maker's rig (supply, leads, ESC), which K09-L does not carry: its own pack, harness and ESC are modelled separately (ASM-E1-PACK-CELLS, electrical.r_ext_mohm, ASM-E1-ESC)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Low stand point: bus held at 11.9 V

nodes.title: Transition thrust margin 1.3
nodes.text: full thrust at every point of the level pitch-over corridor >= 1.3 x the thrust that holds level unaccelerated flight there
nodes.basis: 0.3 g of surplus for acceleration and gusts; same headroom as ASM-A2-GUST-THRUST-HEADROOM

nodes.title: Wing CL: linear to CLmax, flat plate after stall
nodes.text: CL = a alpha up to CLmax (a = 2 pi AR/(AR+2)); above stall CN = 1.98 sin(alpha) (flat plate); prop wash on the wing ignored
nodes.basis: Hoerner flat-plate normal force; ignoring wash lift is conservative for thrust required; B1/B2 refine

nodes.title: Worst pack state for hover T/W
nodes.text: the lowest pack state the aircraft is flown in: the 20 % reserve line (E2 ASM-E2-OCV-20), pack cold-soaked to 10 degC (E2 ASM-E2-COLD-R), windings hot (80 degC, after a hover), the limiter set (ASM-E1-ILIM); pack resistance = cells x R_cell x cold + R_ext (E2's model)
nodes.basis: one definition shared with E2 (CR-E2/E1 reconciliation 2026-11-09); the battery failsafe lands the aircraft at the reserve line, so states below it are emergencies, reported as a sensitivity (3.60 V/cell OCV)

Before D-173: motor body (mount face to bell top) 26.5 mm; bolt-on adapter base 6.35 mm, M6x1 post 15.2 mm above the base; prop hub 0.41 in = 10.41 mm (11x5.5E, D-161; was MR 8.89 mm); M6 washer 1.0 mm; M6 thin nut ISO 4035 3.2 mm (D-161; was ISO 4032 5.2 mm)

The plate and pad heights under the head are D3's (P:fin_detail.mount.*)

nodes.title: Per-unit flying masses incl. leads, g
nodes.text: motor with factory leads 81.0 (no bullets: harness HRN-E03); ESC stripped of its factory power leads (F2 solders its own 16 AWG to the pads, D-48, CR-F2-07) with signal lead and heat-shrink 7.6 (6.6 g bare board + 1.0 g; was 11.0 with 2 x 80 mm 16 AWG); prop 22.96 (11x8E 0.81 oz, D-173); motor 108.0 (X2814 V3 as listed, D-173; X3108S was 81.0); bolt-on adapter 3.0 + 4 x M3x4 1.2 + M6 nut 1.9 + washer 0.6 = 6.7; 4 x M3x8 SHCS motor screws 3.2

reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Fit PER3 to the maker's X3108S + 11x4.7 table
nodes.equation: kT = mean(T_meas / T_PER3(rpm)) ; kP: sum(P_bat,model(rpm) - P_meas) = 0 over rows 5-12 A ; R_th = (94 - 25) / P_loss(30 A row) ; rows > 12 A (second bound): V_supply,min = V_m + I_m R_esc at the measured rpm, R_eff = (14.8 - w / Kv) / I_m

nodes.title: PER3 11x8E factors fitted on the X2814 V3 maker row (APC 11x8, 14.8 V)
nodes.equation: kT = T_maker / T_PER3(rpm_maker) ; kP = Q w / P_PER3(rpm_maker), Q = (I_maker - I0) / Kt (full throttle: winding = battery current; both independent of the maker's supply voltage)

nodes.title: Hover operating point per motor, 11x4.5MR and 11x5.5E/EP
nodes.equation: T_m = m_gate g k_dl / (4 cos cant) ; solve rpm: T(rpm) = T_m ; I_bat, P_bat at V_bus = 14.8 V ; g/W = T_m / g / P_bat ; dT_wind = R_th P_loss

nodes.title: Full-throttle static thrust and current, all four motors
nodes.equation: duty = Q_M_SPIN_MAX (D-173b: the fixed output ceiling; was 1) ; V_bus = V_ocv - R_pack (4 I_bat + I_avn) ; T/W = 4 T_max / (m_gate g) ; cases: table basis (bus held 14.8 V, 25 degC), sag (OCV 14.4 V, R_pack, 80 degC), current limits (bus held 14.8 / 16.8 V, 25 degC)

nodes.title: Full throttle with the pack-current limiter Q_M_BAT_CURR_MAX
nodes.equation: largest duty with 4 I_bat + I_avn <= I_lim ; T/W = 4 T / (m_gate g) ; cases fresh (OCV 16.8 V, 25 degC) and low (OCV 14.4 V, 80 degC), with R_pack

nodes.title: Pack-current limit that holds 25 A in the winding (11x5.5E/EP, fresh pack)
nodes.equation: solve I_lim: I_m(largest duty with 4 I_bat + I_avn <= I_lim) = I_rating ; T/W = 4 T cos(cant) / (m_gate g) at that limit, fresh (4.20 V/cell, warm R, 25 degC winding)

nodes.title: Hover T/W at the worst pack state (E1 station model + E2 pack model)
nodes.equation: R_pack = cells R_cell k_cold + R_ext ; V_ocv = cells OCV ; largest duty with 4 I_bat + I_avn <= I_lim (station model, winding 80 degC) ; T/W = 4 T cos(cant) / (m_gate g) ; f_sag = T_worst / T_fresh (fresh: 4.20 V/cell, warm R, 25 degC)

nodes.title: Path resistance and limiter voltage drop the thrust requirement allows
nodes.equation: R_allow (rev 10: first bound only; the second bound is information) = min over the two cases (and, for information, over the two bounds) of the R_ext at which T/W_worst(R_ext) = T/W_min,sag or T/W_fresh(R_ext) = T/W_min (bisection on the cases of CALC-E1-WORST and CALC-E1-BOUND2), each bound at its own D-148 limiter (first: I_lim, second: I_b2) ; drop_allow = 100 I_lim R_allow / V_nom (both bounds, information: 100 min(I_lim R_allow,1 , I_b2 R_allow,2) / V_nom) ; thrust cost of the path = 1 - T_worst(R_ext) / T_worst(0)

nodes.title: Second bound: the maker's rows above 12 A read as true 14.8 V points (11x5.5E/EP)
nodes.equation: R_eff from the maker's 30 A row (CALC-E1-CAL) replaces R_m + R_esc ; then as CALC-E1-WORST: largest duty with 4 I_bat + I_avn <= I_lim, T/W = 4 T cos(cant) / (m_gate g) ; sensitivity (CDR-AE-01 rule): rpm_full = rpm_full(14.8 V held) x V_bus / 14.8 ; stand point: bus held at V_stand ; T_need = T/W_min,sag m / (4 cos cant)

nodes.title: Second bound against every published full-throttle row of the maker
nodes.equation: held-voltage reading of a full-throttle row (duty <= 1, V_ESC = V_label): V_label d = w / Kv + I_m R, I_m = I_bat / d - P_esc0 / V_label -> R <= R_ub = (V_label - w / Kv) / (I_bat - P_esc0 / V_label) (maker numbers only, no prop model) ; spread = max R_ub / min R_ub (a fixed station has one R) ; second bound at the 11.1 V 11x4.7 row: full throttle on R_eff (CALC-E1-BOUND2) at a held 11.1 V, miss = 1 - T_pred / T_maker ; R_m needed = (R - R_esc) / R_m(T_row) with R_m(T) = R_25 (1 + a (T - 25)) ; first bound at the same row: supply needed at duty 1 = V_m + I_m R_esc at the measured rpm

nodes.title: Prop stack, prop-to-structure gap, nut and motor-screw engagement
nodes.equation: s = L_body + t_base + h_hub / 2 ; x_tip = L_body + t_base + L_post ; e_nut = L_post - h_hub - t_washer - h_nut ; gap = face_ahead + s >= 0.14 D (B4) ; e_screw = L_screw - t_plate (D3 R3: plate canted with the motor, uniform under every head)

nodes.title: Propulsion flying mass, four stations, per-unit masses incl. leads
nodes.equation: m = n (motor + ESC + prop + adapter and nut + motor screws)

nodes.title: Cruise point on B1's polar: four props share the drag
nodes.equation: CL = 2W/(rho V^2 S) ; D = q S (CD0 + k CL^2) trim (B1's as-designed polar, = CALC-B1V-CRUISE drag_gate_n) ; T_m = D / (4 cos cant) ; solve rpm: T(rpm, J) = T_m ; eta_prop = T V / P_shaft ; eta_tot = T V / P_bat ; L/D_eff = W / D ; p_check = (P_55 + avionics) / B1 gate power

nodes.title: Cruise point at the 17 m/s fallback speed (D-96 c, B6), 11x5.5E/EP
nodes.equation: as CALC-E1-CRUISE at V = 17 m/s: D = q S (CD0 + k CL^2) trim ; T_m = D / (4 cos cant) ; P = 4 P_bat(T_m, J) ; ratio = P(17) / P(cruise_ms)

nodes.title: Thrust margin along the level pitch-over corridor (sag case, 11x4.5MR and 11x5.5E/EP)
nodes.equation: min over V in [0, V_tr] of 4 T_full(V cos a, OCV 14.4 V, 80 degC) / T_req,min(V) ; T_req from T sin a + L = W, T cos a >= D ; polar CL-B1V-CD0, CL-B1V-K, ASM-B1-TRIM (rev 8)

nodes.title: One motor out: what is left (11x5.5E/EP)
nodes.equation: hover: thrust/moment balance forces the diagonal partner to 0 -> 2 same-direction motors, T/W_2 = 2 T_max,worst / W, unbalanced yaw torque = 2 Q_hover ; cruise: 2 motors carry D, roll torque = 2 Q(T = D/2) for elevons to hold

nodes.title: Limiter conditions: sensor band (first bound) and the 93 A second-bound case
nodes.equation: first bound, fresh case of CALC-E1-WORST: I_m(I_lim (1 + tol)) <= I_rating ; R_m band (rev 10): R_m,lo: I_m(I_lim (1 + tol); R_m) = I_rating, R_m,hi: T/W(I_lim (1 - tol); R_m) = T/W_min ; T/W(I_lim (1 - tol)) = 4 T cos(cant) / (m g) >= T/W_min ; window [I_lo, I_hi]: T/W(I_lo) = T/W_min, I_m(I_hi) = I_rating ; tol_ok = min(I_hi / I_lim - 1, 1 - I_lo / I_lim) ; second bound at I_b2 as CALC-E1-BOUND2 (and the first bound at I_b2 for the winding)

nodes.title: Winding-resistance design band +/-10 % about 86 mOhm (D-161)
nodes.text: every R-HOVER-TW and R-ESC-CURRENT edge is checked with R_m(25 degC) anywhere in 86 mOhm x (1 +/- band): the low end with the sensor high for the winding current, the high end with the sensor low for T/W
nodes.basis: the maker publishes no tolerance (SRC-E1-X3108S-DATA-111: 86 mOhm, tolerance -); +10 % also covers a winding 26 K above 25 degC at a fresh-pack full-throttle event (0.393 %/K). T-E1-MOTOR-RM (4-wire, corrected to 25 degC) accepts a motor only inside 77.4-94.6 mOhm; the limiter band at 73.2 A (CL-E1-ILIM-RM-LO / -HI) is wider than this

nodes.title: Largest take-off mass that keeps every E1 limit, over the R_m band (D-161)
nodes.equation: T_f = T(fresh, I_lim (1 - tol), R_m (1 + band), 25 degC) ; T_w = T(worst state, I_lim (1 - tol), R_m (1 + band) at 80 degC) ; m_max = min(n T_f cos(cant) / (T/W_min g), n T_w cos(cant) / (T/W_min,sag g)) ; I_wind = I_m(fresh, I_lim (1 + tol), R_m (1 - band), 25 degC) <= I_rating (independent of mass: the limiter fixes the current) ; T/W(m) = n T cos(cant) / (m g) at 2.60, 2.65, 2.70 kg and at cant 10 deg (B3 spare mounts)

nodes.title: One-motor transient at the spin cap, and the gate the limiters allow (D-173b)
nodes.equation: one motor at duty = Q_M_SPIN_MAX, three at hover thrust or 0.3 x hover, fresh pack, R_m (1 - band), 25 degC: I_wind, I_esc ; four motors at min(cap, limiter): fresh T/W at I_lim (1 - tol), R_m (1 + band) ; worst state the same with 80 degC ; m_max = min(n T_f cos / (T/W_min g), n T_w cos / (T/W_sag g)) at limiters 75, 80, 85 A (and the B3 1.75 entry: n T_w cos / (1.75 g))

nodes.title: Lower bound: pure PER3 power (kP = 1)
nodes.equation: as CALC-E1-HOVER and CALC-E1-CRUISE with kP = 1, kT = 1 (cruise T_m = D / (n cos cant))

nodes.title: Hover-current pass line from R-ESC-CURRENT (d)
nodes.equation: I_max = I_hover (1 + tol)

nodes.note: CDR-05 (CDR-AE-02, decision B7): re-stated on the WINDING (phase) current. Until 2026-11-13 this id held the battery-side share of the limiter (24.75 A, now CL-E1-ILIM-I-BAT), which is not what the maker's 25 A / 30 s rating limits. At the limiter the ESC runs at a duty of about 0.83 (CALC-E1-LIMIT duty_fresh_55), so the winding carries about I_bat / duty. Fresh case of CALC-E1-WORST (4.20 V/cell, E2's cell resistance: the case behind the fresh T/W of 2.5); CALC-E1-LIMIT's older fresh case reads 0.5 A less (I_wind_fresh_55_A). Rev 9 (wave 2, D-148): read at performance.full_throttle_current_a 70 A (was 30.0 A at 100 A, FAIL). Holds only with the sensor inside ASM-E1-SENSOR-TOL (T-F1-SENSOR-CAL): the high side of that band is CL-E1-ILIM-I-SENS-HI. Second bound: CL-E1-ILIM-I-B2; the 93 A second-bound value is CALC-E1-ILIM-COND (information)

nodes.title: Cruise electrical power, 11x5.5E/EP
nodes.how: Log pack power in steady 17 m/s FBWA legs, both directions, calm morning; subtract the avionics draw.
nodes.note: propulsion only (no avionics); drag from B1's as-designed polar (CL-B1V-CD0, CL-B1V-K, ASM-B1-TRIM; rev 8, D-67; was CL-B1-CD0 / CL-B1-K), CR-A1-32. p_check = (this + 6 W) / CL-B1V-CRUISE-P-GATE. The params limit is B1's pack power incl. 6 W avionics, so the comparison is 6 W conservative for B1. Rev 8 FAIL: 246.0 W > 240 (E1 + 6 W avionics = 252.0 W, p_check 1.055 against B1's 238.9 W at the gate): same drag (4.51 N), E1's eta_tot 0.293 from APC PER3 with kP 1.24 vs B1's chain. Band 200.2 (kP 1) - 246.0 W. D-13 carries the conservative one: CR-E1-51 asks A1 for cruise_power_w 252 (E2 re-runs) or cruise_ms 15 (213.9 + 6 = 220 W, 1.25 Vs at the gate). Rev 9 (wave 2, D-145 / D-146): at 17 m/s with T_m = D / (4 cos 9 deg); same point as CL-E1-CRUISE-P-55-V17

Previous: D-165b (Closure round 2026-11-14, A1; E1 D-165 at 10 deg / 2.64 kg): 268 -> 269. Previous: D-161 (Closure round 2026-11-14, A1; E1 D-161): E/EP at 17 m/s: 261.5 W + 6 W avionics, rounded up (E1 D-161; was 295 on the MR). Previous: D-157 (Design round 2026-11-14, E1-W2.md): 293 -> 295 W: CL-E1-CRUISE-P-55-V17 288.2 W with the cos 9 deg term + 6 W avionics, rounded up (D-97 rule). Previous: Design round 2026-11-14 (B1-W2.md): B1 cross-check at 17 m/s with the 9 deg cant: 278.2 W (CL-B1V-CRUISE-P-GATE), pessimistic 368.2 W (CL-B1V-CRUISE-P-GATE-PESS); E1/B1 ratio 1.053. D-145 (Design round 2026-11-14): 253 -> 293 W at 17 m/s: E1 286.2 W (CL-E1-CRUISE-P-55-V17) + 6 W avionics = 292.2 W, rounded up (D-97 rule); B1 chain 277.1 W. Previous: D-97 (H10, CR-E1-51, 2026-11-13): 240 -> 253 W, the conservative model carried (D-13 rule): E1 CL-E1-CRUISE-P-55 246.2 W propulsion (APC PER3, kP 1.24, same 4.51 N drag as B1) + 6 W avionics (ASM-B1-AVIONICS-W) = 252.2 W, rounded up. B1's chain gives 238.9 W; the flight log (T-B1-CRUISE-POWER) decides. 15 m/s cruise (220 W) is rejected: it is below 1.3 Vs (15.6 m/s) and below AIRSPEED_MIN 16. Previous: CHANGE-LOG D-49 (E1 CR-E1-24, B1 CR-B1-19, E2 CR-E2-18c; D-13 rule: the conservative one is carried): E1 propulsion power 234 W (band 191-234, kP 1 -> 1.24) + 6 W avionics (ASM-B1-AVIONICS-W) on B1's rev 3 polar. D-67 (B1 CR-B1-20, simulation round): B1's as-designed value at the 2.6 kg gate is 238.9 W (235.2 W at 2.436 kg, CL-B1V-CRUISE-P; CD0 0.0515 -> 0.0579 from the SU2 fin sections, k 0.0957), 1 W under E1's 240: the two models now agree and 240 stands. Pessimistic 312.4 W (CL-B1V-CRUISE-P-PESS; was 300.6). E1 re-runs CL-E1-CRUISE-P-55 on CL-B1V-CD0 / CL-B1V-K. B4 195 W. Was 218 (D-36, B1 rev 2), 307 (11x4.5MR))

nodes.note: RE-CLASSED to information (closure round 2026-11-14, rev 10): the second bound is a rejected reading of the maker table (ASM-E1-BOUND2, CALC-E1-BOUND2-CHECK: CL-E1-B2-MISS-111, CL-E1-R-UB-SPREAD, CL-E1-RM-NEEDED-MIN). No limit, no requirement. The rule CDR-AE-01 used: rpm = rpm(14.8 V) x V_bus / 14.8, with no credit for the smaller resistive drop at the lower current. Here the bus is solved with the pack model at the current this rpm draws (CALC-E1-BOUND2 Vbus_worst_prop_V, above 11.9 V because the limiter does not bind), and the reference rpm is this prop's own (rpm_ref_148). The reviewer's 1.44 (REVIEWER EST) held the bus at 11.9 V and took 7 500 rpm + 3 %: that case is CL-E1-T-STAND-B2-PROP

Rev 10 (closure round): the second bound is information (ASM-E1-BOUND2 rejected), so the value is the first bound's (r_allow_first_mohm); the second bound's r_allow_b2_mohm stays visible. nodes.title: Thrust stand, one station, both candidate props
nodes.procedure: H1 stand (20 kg cell + HX711), X3108S + LANRC 45 A, 11x4.5MR then 11x5.5MR; held 14.8 V bench supply (>= 40 A) and then a flight pack; 10 % throttle steps to 100 %, 3 s each; log gf, A, V, rpm (optical tach or ESC telemetry), can temperature; one 60 s run at 689 gf for g/W; ten 10 -> 100 % throttle punches in < 50 ms with no desync. CDR-04 / CDR-05 additions: bus voltage logged at the ESC pads on every run; full throttle at a held 14.6 V and 11.9 V bus (pass >= 1 330 gf and >= 1 060 gf); phase current on one motor lead (clamp or ESC telemetry) at the limiter duty; one 30 s run at the limiter with the bell temperature (pass <= 80 degC, else the limiter drops to CL-E1-ILIM-FOR-25A)

nodes.title: Incoming check: resistance, no-load current, mass, bolt pattern, hole and thread depth
nodes.procedure: Weigh motor, stripped ESC, prop, adapter set (0.1 g); calipers: base diameter (D3 needs >= 28 mm), base bolt pattern (D3 prints 16 x 19 mm), base hole depth (>= 4.0 mm, CL-E1-HOLE-DEPTH-MIN), bell-top thread length (>= 2.5 mm for D-58; >= 3.0 mm with >= 4.0 mm free depth -> M3x5, CR-A4-43), adapter flange under the screw head, motor phase-lead length from the base (F2's routed reach 0.121 m, CL-F2-PHASE-REACH: if the leads reach, no splice and F2 returns 12 g), ESC strapped on a printed pad (height proud), body length, adapter base and post; on the first built station a printed 25 mm gauge between the blade's aft face at the tip and the CF tube, blade turned through the wing-side position (R-PROP-CLEAR); 4-wire: 2.00 A from a bench supply through two phases, read the voltage drop (R = V / I); no-load current and rpm at 10.0 V without prop (Kv = rpm / (V - I0 R))
