nodes.basis: 16 deg lean at 5 m/s needs T/cos = 1.04 W; P ~ T^1.5 gives +6 %; +4 % for attitude-control activity. Replace with the twin's logged hover current
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Mission profile timings
nodes.text: Ground 180 s at avionics power; climb and descent between 0 and 50 m AGL at 2.0 / 1.0 m/s; forward and back transitions 10 s at 1.4 / 1.3 x hover power (pessimistic 20 s each); hover hold at 50 m before the transition = requirements.hover_time_min x 60 - climb - descent - landing hover 30 s - requirements.goaround_hover_s (D-160: 3.0 min total hover-mode time = 180 - 25 - 50 - 30 - 40 = 35 s hold); the landing hover and the go-around are spent after the cruise and sit in the BATT_LOW landing need (CALC-E2-FAILSAFE); cruise to the reserve line
nodes.basis: R-TEST-ORDER transition at >= 50 m AGL; ArduPilot Q_PILOT_SPD_UP default 2.5 m/s, land 1 m/s; tailsitter pitch-over is a few seconds at high throttle (J1 evidence); doubled for the pessimistic case. Hover split per review/CLOSURE-ROUND-2026-11-14/A2.md s2.1 (D-160); landing hover 30 s includes the last 6 m at 0.3 m/s (Q_LAND_FINAL_ALT 6). Was a fixed 120 s hold with no go-around (E2 closure 2026-11-14)

nodes.title: Cruise mass scaling, circuit factor and independent cross-check model
nodes.text: The cruise power LEVEL is B1's as-designed simulation (CL-B1V-CRUISE-P-GATE at the 2.6 kg gate; CL-B1V-CRUISE-P-PESS at A3's predicted mass CL-A3-MASS-PREDICTED; level flight, avionics included). This E2 drag model (CD0 0.0593, x1.3 pessimistic, e from params, eta_prop 0.47 / 0.35, eta_motor 0.72, trim 1.05) only scales B1's power from B1's reference mass to the budget mass (the pessimistic value up to the gate), and is reported as a cross-check. The turning (circuit) factor 1.05 multiplies B1's level-flight power
nodes.basis: K09 sizing.json CD0 build-up; REVIEW section 4 corrected efficiencies; circuits inside one RFS sub-field spend about half the time in 30 deg banks (induced drag x1.33). CR-E2-08: B1 owns cruise power; E2 follows B1's claims through the proof chain (re-run this script after every B1 re-run)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: 4S pack candidates [name, Ah, listed kg, mass tolerance kg, continuous A, lead AWG, nameplate V/cell]
nodes.text: Row 0 is the named flight pack (D-64); the others are real listed 4S packs, for the trade only
nodes.basis: Listed masses: SRC-E2-OVONIC-120C-EC5, SRC-E2-TATTU-6750, SRC-E2-PACK-SEARCH-1114. Continuous A = realistic cell limit (~30C for 120-130C labels, 25C for the Tattu), not the label C. Tolerance as listed; Muchmore 10 g EST (not stated). Ovonic 50C lead gauge not stated: 12 AWG assumed (EST, Deans plug). E2 closure 2026-11-14 removed the rejected options: Li-ion 4S2P 9 Ah (rejected D-154), Ovonic 130C XT60 680 g 12 AWG (not bought, D-64), Admiral 4S 4000 (no 4000 fallback, D-12), and the unnamed 5000 / 8000 EST classes (no listing). D-163 rows (E2 2026-11-14, SRC-E2-PACK-SEARCH-D163): Gens Ace 448 g +/- 10 listed + 4 g EST for two 0.10 m 10 AWG pigtails with 5 mm bullets (the pack has bullet tubes, no leads); CNHL approx. 479 g, tolerance not stated (10 g EST). Both are LiHV (4.35 V/cell full): the 6.0 Ah is rated at the HV charge. Continuous 180 A = 30C EST. D-168 (E2 2026-11-14): CNHL LiHV 6000 re-read on chinahobbyline.com.au: 479 +/- 5 g, 138 x 47 x 37 mm, 12 AWG (12#), EC5, out of stock -> fails the 10 AWG rule; CNHL Lightning 6700 4S LiHV EC5 about 530 g, 10 AWG, 149 x 51 x 35 mm (chinahobbyline.com, ja page), tolerance not stated (10 g EST). Last column = the pack's nameplate cell voltage, used as its average OCV by the ASM-E2-OCV-AVG rule (3.70 LiPo, 3.80 LiHV: 15.2 V / 4 on the listings)

nodes.title: Test-day window and turnaround
nodes.text: Flying window 180 min (07:00-10:00 flight card); 20 min on the ground between sorties (log check, feet and prop inspection, pack swap, re-brief); one fully charged pack per sortie; no charging at the field
nodes.basis: R-SITE flight card; CONFIGURATION.md morning-only; RFS mains power not confirmed, and P21 forbids car charging

nodes.title: Turbulator cruise power adder 14.0 W (D-168)
nodes.text: The lower-surface zigzag trip (wing.turbulator) adds 14.0 W electrical at 17 m/s on top of E1's untripped cruise point CL-E1-CRUISE-P-55-V17
nodes.basis: B2.md B2C-3 (XFOIL, upper bound). Added to the E1-based chains (CALC-E2-BUDGET-V17, -240, -PACK-TRADE) and scaled with them into the pessimistic case. Remove once E1 / B1 carry the trip in their own cruise power
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Charge profile
nodes.text: CC at min(1C, charger W / 16.8 V) to ~85 % state of charge, then CV for 20 min
nodes.basis: standard LiPo CC-CV; 1C is the maker's normal charge rate for hobby packs

nodes.title: Energy budget per phase, base case (sized mass)
nodes.equation: I = (Voc - sqrt(Voc^2 - 4 R P)) / (2 R) per phase ; Ah = I t ; P_cruise = P_B1(gate) x circuit x P_E2(m) / P_E2(gate) ; t_cruise = (C - 0.2 C - sum Ah_fixed) / I_cruise

nodes.title: Energy budget per phase, pessimistic (2.6 kg gate)
nodes.equation: as base, with m = gate, C x 0.92, R x 1.5 (10 degC), P_hover x 1.10, P_cruise = B1 as-designed pessimistic (CL-B1V-CRUISE-P-PESS at A3 predicted mass) x P_E2,pess(gate) / P_E2,pess(m_pred) x circuit, 20 s transitions

nodes.title: Bus voltage at the 100 A limiter vs pack state; bracket on the thrust factor
nodes.equation: V_bus = Voc - R I_lim (limiter binds when I_unlim(V) = n I_148 (V/14.8)^2 > I_lim) ; thrust factor worst/fresh bracketed by (V_w/V_f) (thrust prop. to power) and (V_w/V_f)^(2/3) (ideal rotor at fixed current) ; old rule (V/V_tab)^2 kept for the record (unlimited motor) ; bracket margin = min(f_E1 - lower, upper - f_E1)

nodes.title: Pack self-heating over the pessimistic mission, cold and hot mornings
nodes.equation: Q = sum(I^2 R t) over phases ; dT = Q / (m c) (adiabatic, c = 1000 J/kg K) ; T_end = T_amb + dT ; cold: 10 degC, R x 1.5 ; hot: 30 degC, R x 1.0

nodes.title: Pack trade: candidates against the pack acceptance line, R-MISSION as flown (cruise at 17 m/s to BATT_LOW) and current
nodes.equation: P_cruise = performance.cruise_power_w + ASM-E2-TURB-W (D-173) ; pass = (m_listed + tol <= CL-A3-PACK-ACCEPT) AND t_to_low(17 m/s, pessimistic, gate mass, this pack's Ah and BATT_LOW) >= cruise_time_min AND land_left >= BATT_CRT AND I_cont >= I_limiter AND AWG <= 10 ; BATT_LOW and t_to_low as CALC-E2-FAILSAFE / -BUDGET-V17 ; named_pass_ah = Ah of row 0 if it passes else 0

nodes.title: Battery failsafe thresholds for the flight controller
nodes.equation: CRT_MAH = reserve C ; LOW_MAH = CRT + Ah(back-transition + descent + 60 s return cruise + 30 s landing hover + goaround_hover_s go-around at hover current, D-160), pessimistic currents, rounded up to 100 mAh ; the FC counts mAh used against BATT_CAPACITY = the pack's measured capacity (D-154; pessimistic pack = cap_frac x C), so BATT_LOW fires after (cap_frac C - LOW_MAH) used ; t_to_low = (cap_frac C - LOW_MAH - Ah before cruise) / I_cruise ; charge at touchdown after a QRTL from the far point = LOW_MAH - need

nodes.title: Sorties per test day and charge time
nodes.equation: sorties_window = floor(window / (t_flight + t_turn)) ; sorties = min(packs, window) (D-12: 2) ; window used = sorties t_flight + (sorties - 1) t_turn ; t_charge = (0.85 - 0.20) C / I_cc + t_cv ; I_cc = min(1C, P_chg / 16.8 V)

nodes.title: Charger output 150 W
nodes.text: HTRC C150 delivers 150 W into one pack on AC
nodes.basis: BOM line 'HTRC C150 charger 150 W AC'; output vs input rating to confirm from the manual
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Named pack SKU against the pack pass line of record (CL-A3-PACK-ACCEPT, D-154), the bay and the lead rule
nodes.equation: accept = CL-A3-PACK-ACCEPT / 1000 (PACK_ACCEPT_KG, read live) ; m_worst = m_listed + tol ; mass margin = accept - m_worst ; bay clearance = min_i(bay_i - (size_i + tol)) (pack length along the bay) ; lead AWG number <= awg_max

nodes.title: Budget sensitivity at the params cruise power (performance.cruise_power_w: 293 W at 17 m/s since D-145; 253 W D-97, 240 W D-49)
nodes.equation: as CALC-E2-BUDGET-BASE / -PESS with B1's level cruise power x k, k = P_params / P_B1 (base: params cruise power / B1V level power at the gate; pessimistic: B1V pessimistic x the same k) ; BATT_LOW count as CALC-E2-FAILSAFE (counter = measured capacity, D-154)

nodes.title: Budget at 17 m/s on E1's cruise point (performance.cruise_ms 17, D-145)
nodes.equation: as CALC-E2-BUDGET-240 with the params cruise power replaced by E1's 17 m/s point: k = (P_E1(17 m/s) + P_avionics) / P_B1(17 m/s, gate) ; base = B1 level power x k ; pessimistic = B1 pessimistic power (17 m/s, B1-W2) x the same k (EST: E1's / B1's base ratio applied to the pessimistic power) ; BATT_LOW count as CALC-E2-FAILSAFE with the 17 m/s cruise current, counter = measured capacity (D-154)

nodes.title: E1's worst/fresh thrust factor lies inside E2's physical bracket (D-35)
nodes.how: T-E1-STAND fresh and worst-state runs: measured thrust ratio between the measured bus-voltage ratio and its 2/3 power.
nodes.note: D-35 resolved: E2 adopts E1's station model (CL-E1-SAG-FACTOR, CL-E1-TW-WORST) as the one worst-state claim. The limiter binds in every pack state, so the pack current is fixed at the limiter and thrust follows power (lower bound, thrust ~ V) or the ideal rotor (upper, ~ V^(2/3)); E1 lies between. Retires CL-E2-SAG-F-WORST and CL-E2-TW-SAG-WORST (the (V/14.8)^2 rule counted the sag twice)

nodes.title: Cruise before BATT_LOW (QRTL) fires, pessimistic pack, counter = measured capacity, at B1's cruise point
nodes.how: SITL with the logged currents and BATT_CAPACITY = measured: QRTL must not trigger before requirements.cruise_time_min (3.5 min, D-160) of cruise.
nodes.note: What this measures: R-MISSION as flown. Minutes of cruise, after ground, climb, the hover hold and the forward transition, before the flight controller's mAh counter reaches BATT_LOW_MAH and commands QRTL, on the pessimistic pack (92 % of nameplate, cold, gate mass). The counter counts against BATT_CAPACITY = the pack's measured capacity (D-154), and BATT_LOW_MAH holds the energy to come back and land, one 40 s hover go-around (D-160) and the 20 % reserve. It is stricter than CL-E2-CRUISE-MIN-PESS*, which cruises to the 20 % line and keeps nothing for the return. Before D-154 the counter base was 6 500 mAh, which spent the reserve on a 92 % pack
reasons: FAILS: margin -10.7% (3.126 min vs >= 3.5 min)

nodes.title: Weigh and measure every pack on arrival

nodes.title: Discharge capacity test at 1C
nodes.procedure: Charger discharge mode is limited in power: discharge through the thrust stand at ~6.5 A to 3.5 V/cell under load, log mAh with the watt meter; pass >= 6.0 Ah (R-PACK-MASS).

nodes.title: Pack resistance by load step
nodes.procedure: Thrust stand, one motor: rest voltage, then 20 A step; R = dV / dI after 2 s; repeat at 10 degC (pack 1 h in a fridge, bagged). Pass <= 5 mOhm/cell at 25 degC.

nodes.title: Full-mission current log

nodes.title: Prusament ASA technical data sheet v1.1 (May 2024)
nodes.where: HDT 93 degC at 0.45 MPa (ISO 75), from the search snippet of the Italian TDS 2026-11-09; other ASA brands 100-101 degC

nodes.title: Silicon Labs EFM8BB21F16G-C-QFN20 (BLHeli_S ESC MCU) temperature grade
nodes.where: 'G' grade -40 to +85 degC operating (Silicon Labs device page; Arrow, Farnell listings agree). The LANRC 45 A ESC publishes no temperature rating

nodes.title: STM32F405RGT6 ambient rating -40 to +85 degC (6-suffix)
nodes.where: checked 2026-11-02 for the previous design (docs/research/thermal.md section 4); the F405 wing boards on the shortlist use this part. IMU ICM-42688-P is rated to +85 degC too

nodes.title: LiPo discharge temperature rating 60 degC (hobby pack norm)
nodes.where: hobby LiPo makers state discharge -20 to +60 degC and advise landing below ~50 degC for life; Ovonic page not opened (rate-limited); confirm on the pack label/manual on arrival

nodes.title: Air properties at 300 K
nodes.text: kinematic viscosity, conductivity, Prandtl number used in every film coefficient
nodes.basis: Incropera Table A.4; within +-6 % from 10 to 40 degC, so held constant

nodes.title: Motor specific heat 540 J/kg K
nodes.text: one lumped node of 81 g: copper ~20 g, laminations ~25 g, aluminium bell and base ~20 g, magnets and shaft ~16 g
nodes.basis: mass-weighted c_p (Cu 385, Fe 450, Al 900, NdFeB 440, steel 470) = 520-560
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Motor thermal resistance 1.5 K/W (design)
nodes.text: winding-to-ambient resistance in its own prop wash used for the design case; E1's 1.0 K/W is the nominal case
nodes.basis: E1 back-solved 0.83 K/W from the maker's 94 degC at the 30 A row, a test that was probably not steady, so the true value is higher; an outer-surface-only correlation (rotating bell, no internal ventilation) gives ~3 K/W, a bound. 1.5 x nominal until T-E3-MOTOR-TAU
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: ESC body 45 x 20 x 6 mm, 11 g, 700 J/kg K
nodes.text: LANRC 45 A in heat-shrink, strapped flat on the fin pad, FET side out; the pad face is adiabatic (foam board); the leads' fin effect is ignored (conservative)
nodes.basis: typical 45 A BLHeli_S 2-6S board size (LANRC publishes no drawing; propulsion_detail.esc.size_m); mass 7.6 g stripped (D-48: 6.6 g bare board + 1.0 g signal lead and shrink, A3 overrides.csv PRP-002; was 11 g with factory leads); c_p FR4 + copper + parts. Measure on arrival
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: ESC pad centre at x 0.101 m, 0.072 m from the motor axis (D3 layout)
nodes.text: pad FIN-007 on the half-fin face from x 0.078 to 0.124 m, centre |z| 0.118 m (72 mm toward the wing from the motor axis), ESC long side along x; the 20 mm wide ESC spans 62-82 mm from the axis
nodes.basis: subsystems/fins/params.json fin_detail.esc_pad (x0 0.078, len 0.046, z 0.118; D3 R2, CL-D3-ESC-WASH), which replaces E3's R1 proposal (x 0.10, 60 mm). Inside the contracted slipstream, clear of the hub wake (r < 30 mm)

nodes.title: Hook-and-loop strap covers 320 mm2 of the ESC's exposed faces
nodes.text: one 10 mm strap through the two pad slots wraps the ESC once: it covers 10 mm x (20 + 2 x 6) mm of the FET face and sides, which then reject no heat (conservative)
nodes.basis: fins BUILD.md / params fin_detail.esc_pad.slot_m (10 mm strap); ESC 45 x 20 x 6 (ASM-E3-ESC): exposed 1 680 mm2 -> 1 360 mm2 (-19 %)

nodes.title: Local-velocity factor at the ESC 0.7 nominal / 0.5 design
nodes.text: velocity over the ESC = factor x the slipstream (hover) or free-stream (cruise) velocity, for the motor-tube wake and the fin boundary layer
nodes.basis: the pad is 2.5 tube diameters behind the 22 mm tube, on its wake centreline; a cylinder wake keeps a 0.3-0.5 velocity deficit there; the 6 mm ESC sits inside a 3-6 mm fin boundary layer. Measure with a hot-wire or the ESC temperature on the stand (T-E3-ESC-PAD)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Emissivity 0.9, still-air film 8 W/m2 K
nodes.text: heat-shrink, solder mask, anodised and painted surfaces; natural convection on small parts with no flow
nodes.basis: Incropera Table 1.1 (free convection, gases 2-25); radiation linearised at the part temperature

nodes.title: Pack c_p 1 000 J/kg K, cell R 5 mOhm design, R(T) x 1.5 per 15 K below 25 degC
nodes.text: pack heat = I^2 x cells x R_cell(T); R_cell = 4 mOhm nominal (E2), 5 mOhm design (E2's T-E2-IR acceptance limit); R(T) = R25 x 1.5^((25 - T)/15) below 25 degC, R25 above (no credit for warm cells)
nodes.basis: E2 ASM-E2-R-CELL, ASM-E2-COLD-R and T-E2-IR pass value; c_p as E2 (LiPo 1 000-1 100)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Flight controller top board 52 x 32 mm, 15 J/K; the R2 2.0 W lumped value is kept as the bound
nodes.text: FC node = CoreWing F405 Wing APP V2 top board + wireless board alone, on four 5 mm gel cubes, both faces exchange with the pod air; its dissipation now comes from F3 (CALC-E3-* read ASM-F3-5V-LOADS); the 5 V regulator sits on the separated power board PWR-003
nodes.basis: subsystems/avionics/params.json fc_board_m [0.052, 0.032] and fc_mass_g 12 (c ~ 1 000 J/kg K + gel and strap -> 15 J/K); F3-R2 split of the stack (CR-F3-13). Index 0 is the R2 bound (2.0 W total, F3's limit line for CL-F3-FC-DISS)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Other pod heat: power-board regulator + idle from F3, UBEC 0.8 W, design factor 1.25
nodes.text: heat released straight into the pod air by the CoreWing power board PWR-003 (5 V regulator losses and servo-BEC idle: CL-F3-FC-DISS minus the FC's own 5 V x (FC + wireless) load) and by the servo UBEC PWR-005 (right channel); every pod source (FC, power board, UBEC) is multiplied by the design factor until T-F3-5V runs
nodes.basis: UBEC: two elevon servos, mean 0.3-0.5 A at 6.0 V in gusty flight = 1.8-3.0 W out, eta 0.80 -> 0.45-0.75 W; 0.8 W carried. Factor 1.25 for unmeasured loads (F3 5 V budget is EST)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Harness resistance inside the pod 2.9 mOhm
nodes.text: of F1's 6.5 mOhm pack-to-ESC path only the common path (pack leads, AS150U, bus board, fuse) is inside the pod; the four 14.5 mOhm ESC branches (3.6 mOhm equivalent) run in the wing and fins and their heat leaves there
nodes.basis: params electrical.r_ext_mohm note (D-32): 'common path 2.9 + four 14.5 branches in parallel'. R2 put E2's old 3 mOhm all in the pod; reading the new 6.5 mOhm whole would double-count 3.6 mOhm of wing wiring
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Power scaling from the 2.6 kg gate to the as-designed mass
nodes.text: hover, climb, transitions and descent: P ~ m^1.5 (momentum theory, constant figure of merit); cruise: P ~ m^1.0 (about half the cruise drag is induced at 16 m/s, so dP/P = 2 x 0.5 x dm/m); currents scale with power; cruise time re-solved so the mission still ends on E2's 20 % line (same energy as the gate table)
nodes.basis: E2 ASM-E2-CRUISE-AERO scales B1's level-flight power with mass the same way; induced share 0.4-0.6 at CL 0.37 (B1)

nodes.title: CF motor tube as a cooling fin below the mount
nodes.text: 22 x 20 mm CF tube, axial conductivity 5 W/m K (quasi-isotropic layup, fibre share along the axis), outer surface in the slipstream at the CFD film coefficient, inside still; root at the mount temperature (taken = motor peak, conservative); PETG station collar 30 mm below
nodes.basis: CF/epoxy tubes 3-10 W/m K along the axis (roll-wrapped); collar distance subsystems/fins/params.json station_collar note ('30 mm below the motor plate')
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Pod shell and vents
nodes.text: shell foam board 5 mm, k 0.035 W/m K, the face on the wing adiabatic; pod air 10 J/K; recommended vents: inlet 15 x 30 mm at the pod nose and an equal exit at the rear, internal velocity 0.25 x airspeed in cruise, no vent flow credited in hover
nodes.basis: foam board k 0.03-0.04; vent sizing as the previous design (docs/research/thermal.md 6.4); 0.25 for inlet and internal losses EST

nodes.title: Mission order and hover split
nodes.text: chronological order of E2's phases: ground, climb, first hover (half of the hover row), forward transition, cruise, back-transition, second hover, descent; motors off on the ground; climb, hover, transitions and descent use the static prop law; the abuse case adds 30 s at the 100 A limiter after the first hover
nodes.basis: mission profile params.json#mission.profile; E2 ASM-E2-PROFILE; E1 CR-E1-10 (full throttle <= 30 s)

nodes.title: Temperature limits
nodes.text: motor winding/stator 80; PETG mount HDT 68; ASA mount HDT 93; ESC 85; pack 60 rating and 50 at landing for life; FC 85 degC
nodes.basis: motor: previous test-plan abort value (SunnySky publishes none; the maker's own test reached 94 degC); PETG and ASA: TDS HDT at 0.45 MPa; ESC: EFM8BB21 G-grade MCU; pack: hobby LiPo rating (E2 uses 50 at landing); FC: STM32F405 and IMU rating
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Morning sun 700 W/m2, absorptivity 0.9 dark / 0.3 white, outside film 20 W/m2 K, 600 s soak
nodes.text: parked aircraft at set-up, sun on the pod top
nodes.basis: clear April morning 09-10 h; Incropera Table 1.1; five-minute set-up plus waiting
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Ambient sweep 15, 20, 25, 30 degC
nodes.text: field ambients at which every temperature is reported for the mission table; the pack starts at ambient (E2's >= 20 degC warm-up rule is not modelled, so the 15 degC row is a cold-pack row)
nodes.basis: E3 task scope 2026-11-09 (15-30 degC); params env.ambient_design_c is [10, 30] and its cold end stays in CL-E3-PACK-RISE-COLD

nodes.title: H1 GT-04 stand sequence
nodes.text: one station on the stand with the ESC on the half-fin mock-up: 120 s at 690 gf hover thrust, 10 s at the 25 A limiter share, 60 s at hover thrust, then stop; no forward flow
nodes.basis: team/H1/GROUND-TEST-PLAN.md GT-04 step 1 (CR-H1-06)

nodes.title: Mission temperatures at the top of the design ambient (30 degC)
nodes.equation: per node C dT/dt = Q(t, T) - sum G (T - T_neighbour) ; Q_motor = I_m^2 R_m(T) + I0 n/Kv, Q_esc = I_m^2 R_esc + P_fix with I_m from P_bus = I_m (n/Kv + I_m R_m) + Q_esc and Q = kP Q_B4 (n/n_B4)^2 ; ESC h = 0.664 Re^0.5 Pr^1/3 k/L at f_wake v(x), v(x) = v_i (1 + x/sqrt(x^2+R^2)) + 4 eps sigma T^3 ; pack Q = I^2 N R_cell(T) ; explicit Euler dt 0.5 s, pod air relaxed exactly
reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

nodes.title: Field-ambient ceiling per part (design case, mission and hover-only sortie)
nodes.equation: T_amb,max(part) = max T_amb such that peak T_part(T_amb) <= limit (bisection on the full model) ; ceiling = min over parts ; pack starts at ambient
reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

nodes.title: Model checks: time-step convergence, steady hover vs hand value, pack vs E2
nodes.equation: convergence: peaks at dt 1.0 / 0.5 / 0.25 s ; steady: T_mot - T_amb -> Q_m R_th after 15 tau ; pack: adiabatic, R x 1.0 at 30 degC and x 1.5 at 10 degC, E2 phase order -> E2's dT
reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

nodes.title: Pre-flight sun soak of the pack in the pod
nodes.equation: T_sol-air - T_amb = alpha G / h_o ; Q = G_top (T_sa - T_amb), G_top = A_top / (t/k + 1/h_o) ; dT_pack <= Q t / (m c) (all of it reaching the pack: upper bound)
reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

nodes.title: Operating limits: full-throttle burst length and pack start temperature (design, 30 degC)
nodes.equation: burst: max t such that peak T_motor <= 80 degC and T_esc <= 85 degC with t s at the limiter after the first hover ; pack: max T_start such that T_pack(landing) <= 50 degC (bisection)
reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

nodes.title: Mission temperatures across the 15-30 degC field ambient (design and nominal)
nodes.equation: as CALC-E3-MISSION, repeated at each ambient of ASM-E3-AMB-SWEEP ; rows [T_amb, motor peak, ESC peak, pack at landing, FC peak, pod-air peak] in degC
reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

nodes.title: Predicted rises for the H1 GT-04 stand sequence (CR-H1-06)
nodes.equation: rpm from thrust n = n_B4 sqrt(T / (kT T_B4)) ; bus power from the motor model at 25 degC ; RC network of CALC-E3-MISSION with the static slipstream, sequence ASM-E3-GT04 ; rise = T - T_amb at stop (what the IR reads) ; scaled-to-30 degC = T_meas - T_amb,test + 30
reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

nodes.title: CF motor tube as a fin: temperature at the PETG station collar (design, 30 degC)
nodes.equation: T(x) - T_amb = (T_root - T_amb) cosh(m (L - x)) / cosh(m L) -> long fin: theta(x)/theta_0 = exp(-m x), m = sqrt(h P / (k A)), P = pi D_o, A = pi (D_o^2 - D_i^2) / 4 ; h = CFD film at the design hover slipstream ; root at the motor peak

nodes.title: Motor (winding/stator) peak, design mission at 30 degC
nodes.how: Thermocouple (K type) on the part, mission flown or run on the stand at the stated power, log every 5 s; T-E3-MOTOR-TAU fits R_th and tau on the stand; T-E3-MISSION reads the can by IR within 30 s of landing.

nodes.title: Motor thermal resistance and time constant on the thrust stand
nodes.procedure: One station on the H1 stand with the real printed mount, 11x5.5MR, 14.8 V. K-type thermocouples on the stator (through the base vent), between base and mount, and on the bell (IR). From ambient: hover power (~100 W bus) for 10 min, log every 5 s; fit T = T_inf - (T_inf - T_0) e^(-t/tau): R_th = (T_inf - T_amb) / loss, loss = P_in - torque x omega. Then 30 s at 24.8 A. Pass: R_th <= 1.5 K/W, base < 83 degC (ASA) at hover power from 30 degC; tube at the station collar < 58 degC (PETG).

nodes.title: ESC on a fin-pad mock-up in the slipstream
nodes.procedure: Foam-board half-fin with a 22 mm tube LE behind the stand prop; ESC strapped on the pad at x 0.101 m, 0.072 m from the axis, FET side out; thermocouple under the heat-shrink on the FETs. Hover power 10 min, then 30 s at the limiter. Tuft on the pad. Back-solve the wake factor: f = (h_meas / h_model)^2. Pass: <= 70 degC steady at hover power from 30 degC (15 K below the MCU rating).

nodes.title: Temperatures after the first full missions
nodes.procedure: Field ambient from the handheld anemometer/thermometer at take-off; IR on the four motor cans, ESCs and the pack within 60 s of landing; IMU.T and BAT current from the log. Compare with the model re-run at the measured ambient: within +-8 K, else update ASM-E3-RTH-DESIGN / ASM-E3-WAKE.

nodes.title: ESC input capacitors: ripple current, ripple voltage, spike, can temperature (X2814 V3 + 11x8E, 75 A)
nodes.equation: square-wave ESC input current between 0 and I_ph at duty D: I_cap,rms = I_ph sqrt(D (1 - D)) <= 0.5 I_ph, all of it in the added cans (the LANRC's own caps and the leads not credited); limiter: I_ph = winding at the band edge, D = I_bat / I_ph; hover, heavier motor: 0.5 x I_wind,hover x 2s/(1+s); single-motor transient at the static cap: I_ph = 49.3 A, D = 40 / 49.3. Per can / n. Permissible per can = I0 x k_freq x k_temp (maker multipliers). Thermal-window RMS over tau = R_th C_th with t_lim at the limiter + the transient, rest hover. V_pp = I_ph (k_esr ESR / n) + I_ph D (1 - D) / (f n C). Spike = I_bat sqrt(L_lead / (n C)) + I_ph k_esr ESR / n; V_peak = V_full + spike + V_pp / 2. T_core = T_amb + R_th I^2 k_esr ESR
reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

nodes.title: Longest 16 AWG ESC lead that keeps the limiter-current drop within E1's allowable

nodes.note: CDR-03 / CDR-EL-04 (2026-11-13): the limit is back. R5 had removed the limit when the XT30U (D-74) put the 5 % guideline length below the longest lead; that length is CL-F1-ESC-LEN-5PCT.

nodes.title: Wire heat runs
nodes.procedure: Bench supply (>= 40 A) + load; built power stack (10 AWG jumpers, power board) in a closed pod mock-up at 30 A, 16 AWG pair in a taped XPS groove at 8.4 A, two pairs through a 50 mm straw at 8.4 A each, each 10 min; K-type thermocouples mid-lead under foam tape; then 50 A for 2 s on the 16 AWG. Pass: rise <= 10 degC steady (jumpers: above their joints), <= 30 degC peak, pack leads <= 20 degC.

nodes.title: AS150U and XT60H heat runs
nodes.procedure: AS150U: 38 A for 10 min, then 75 A for 10 s; XT60H: 10 A 10 min, then 40 A 2 s and 50 A 2 s; IR on the housings; rise <= 30 degC.

nodes.title: Path resistance
nodes.procedure: 20 A load step from the pack; meter across pack terminals and across one ESC's pads; R = dV/dI. Pass: drop <= 2 % at 30 A; R_ext <= CL-E1-REXT-ALLOW.

nodes.title: Current sensor calibration
nodes.procedure: Clamp meter on the main lead at 5, 15, 25, 30 A (motors on the restrained frame); set BATT_AMP_PERVLT so BAT.Curr is within +/-1.1 % at 25-30 A (D-157); record the value for F4. Voltage: BATT_VOLT_MULT within 0.1 V of a meter at the battery pads (BOARD-CHECK.md step 8); the +/-0.5 % voltage line of D-161c is dropped with the Lua spin cap (D-173b, static Q_M_SPIN_MAX).

nodes.title: Servo stall current and rail voltage
nodes.procedure: Each servo blocked at full deflection 2 s on the power-board servo BEC (6 V jumper), meter in series: pass <= 2.0 A per servo (the factor-2 limit on the 8 A BEC); both together: Vx >= 5.8 V at the servo and FC 5 V >= 4.8 V (as BOARD-CHECK.md step 7, with the real servos).

nodes.title: Anti-spark behaviour
nodes.procedure: Scope on the bus while plugging the AS150U slowly; bus >= 95 % before the main pins close; no spark marks after 20 plug cycles.

nodes.title: ESC supply ripple and cap heating
nodes.procedure: Stand, one station, Bluejay 48 kHz: current probe on one cap pair's legs and scope at the ESC pads at hover power 120 s, then a 10 s limiter punch, a single-motor step to the 0.81 cap and a throttle chop. Pass: per-can RMS <= CL-F1-CAP-RATING, can rise <= 15 K after 120 s (IR), <= 1.0 V p-p, no spike above 21 V.

nodes.title: Mount-stiffness rig: optical lever and load steps
nodes.text: T-C4-MOUNT-STIFF read by a laser pointer reflected off a 10 mm mirror bonded to the motor can, onto mm paper on a wall L = 5.0 m away (spot moves 2 theta L); a second mirror on the collar subtracts tube and stub rotation. Spot centre read to +/-0.3 mm from a tripod phone photo against a 1 mm grid. Loads 0.5, 1.0, 1.7 kg at the prop nut (CDR-28: top step 1.5 -> 1.7 kg, so the U95 at the pass line is under 10 %; still under 0.8 x the mount proof load). For comparison, C4's two dial gauges (0.01 mm) are 0.030 m apart.
nodes.basis: optical lever is the standard way to read sub-milliradian rotations without a fine gauge; R3: wall 3.0 -> 5.0 m (a corridor) and photo read-out, because C4's need rose to ~1 970 N m/rad (15:01 re-publish) and the spot shrinks with it; laser pointer and mirror are team-owned

nodes.basis: Roark, thin circular ring under diametral load (case of two opposite point loads); a standard way to get the hoop modulus of a wound tube without a strain gauge
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

Pivot and the three clevis holes in a pair of 3 mm steel side plates 40 x 200 mm, each plate held to the lever by 6 x M6 through-bolts (was 4: the 20:1 hole raises the pivot load and 4 bolts would bear on the wood at 4.5 MPa against 4.3); lever tare balanced by a counterweight on the short side. Water filled slowly from a hose; jug weighed after failure.
nodes.basis: CR-C6-39 asks >= 2 660 N for the strip anchor; 15:1 x 20 kg = 2 940 N. The 9:1 hole keeps resolution for the 40-300 N coupons. Steel plates because bare wood across the grain does not carry the pivot bearing (CALC-H1-LEVER)

nodes.title: Strain-gauge read-out: half bridge (active + dummy) on an HX711 at reduced excitation
nodes.text: 350 ohm foil gauges, gauge factor 2.0 +/-1 %, grid 3 x 2.5 mm (I1 G13). Each active gauge is paired with a dummy gauge bonded on an unloaded offcut of the same material beside the article (temperature compensation), completed by two 350 ohm 0.1 % resistors; one HX711 per bridge (G06 and G12 boards), channel A gain 128. The HX711's 4.3 V excitation is dropped to the bridge through 1.5 kohm in each lead (self-heating on paper over foam). Noise 0.1 uV rms after averaging (2 x the datasheet's 50 nV at 10 SPS for the leads). Shunt calibration: 100 kohm across the dummy arm.
nodes.basis: Vishay TN-502 self-heating guidance: <= 0.05 W/in2 (78 W/m2) on poor heat sinks such as plastics and foam laminates; a dummy gauge on the same substrate cancels apparent strain
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Restrained four-motor run (CR-A2-25)
nodes.procedure: Card GT-13: aircraft strapped at the four root eyes after T-H1-RESTRAINT-PULL; fresh pack; QSTABILIZE, 2 s full throttle: BAT.Curr <= 100 A, each ESC rpm <= the cap (Q_M_SPIN_MAX 0.84), per-motor current <= 25 A from ESC telemetry; then 30 s at hover throttle for compassmot (T-F3-COMPASSMOT).

nodes.title: Pack retention pull with a dummy pack (GT-10)
nodes.procedure: Card GT-10: pack-size plywood/sand dummy at the heaviest GT-05 pack mass, strapped as flown; pull CL-H1-PACK-PULL-F in +-x, +-y, +z with jugs over a pulley or a luggage scale, 10 s each; slip <= 5 mm, hatch stays closed. Never a LiPo.

nodes.title: Arm refusal and kill switch, props off (GT-12)
nodes.procedure: Card GT-12: arm refused with each failed pre-arm check; kill switch at 50 % throttle, 5 trials, switch edge to all RCOU at disarm in the log <= CL-H1-ESTOP-ACCEPT.

nodes.title: Coupon lever calibration, both holes
nodes.procedure: Card GT-15 step 0: tare the lever with the short-side counterweight (jug hook empty, lever level); 3.000 kg check mass at the 15:1 clevis, balance with water at the jug hook, ratio = 3.000 / jug mass, 3x, within 2 % of 15.0; same with 2.000 kg at the 9:1 clevis, within 2 % of 9.0. Then a 20 kg jug on the 15:1 hole against a steel bar coupon for 60 s: no crack at the plates, no bolt set.

nodes.title: Readout checks: optical lever, tube deflection and twist, tap acquisition, inclinometer, strain-gauge bridges, ESC-dummy thermocouples
nodes.procedure: Optical lever: 1.00 mm shim under the mirror base edge, spot step matches 2 L t/b; both torsion lasers on the same shim; caliper or dial on a 1.00 mm gauge block; FC raw IMU logs a 200 Hz phone-speaker tone at the right bin; phone inclinometer against a 30 deg printed wedge; each gauge bridge: 60 s zero (2 sigma), 10 min drift <= 5 ue unloaded, shunt step within 1 % of CL-H1-SG-SHUNT; three thermocouples together in still air read within 0.3 K.

nodes.note: FAILS on the bare tube: f1 ~183 Hz sits 2 % from the hover 2P (180 Hz) and 9 % from the cruise 2P (200 Hz). The forcing sweeps 90-156 Hz (1P) and 180-312 Hz (2P) between hover and the capped maximum, so no bare-tube mode in 72-374 Hz clears 20 % at every steady point: the fin bond must put the first mode above ~375 Hz, or the tap test must show it damped (R-VIBRATION allows either). C4 owns the fix. D-100 (2026-11-13): no limit and no requirement link: the bare tube is not the design; C4's 3-D station model of the bonded fin (CL-C4-SIM-SEP) and T-C4-TAP-D3 are the claim and test of record for R-VIBRATION.

nodes.title: Static margin trimmable, elevons neutral (S5010)
nodes.how: B2: XFOIL cm at the cruise Re (~3.5e5) with elevon deflection; B3: AVL trim at the cruise CL and SM 5 %. Flight: elevon trim position in FBWA (A2 limit elevon_trim_travel_max).

The S5010's cm0 is about zero (-0.004 at Re 2.3e5, +0.003 at 3e5, B2), so elevons-neutral it trims no positive static margin (-0.9 %): all 5 % of SM is carried by elevon up-trim (B2: about -4 deg at CL 0.5), and that penalty is already inside the trimmed CLmax 0.80 (CL-B2-CLMAX-DESIGN). The MH 45's +0.0145 would have trimmed 3.3 % at this CL. R-STATIC-MARGIN is verified by B3's CL-B3-CG-AFT, not by this screen.

nodes.note: D-174 (Closure round 2026-11-14, A1; E1 D-173 applied, E2 D-173 pack): 2.64 -> 2.7. physical gate at the 80 A limiter: propulsion allows 2.755 kg with B3 1.75 entry (E1 D-173 applied); landing to ~2.84 kg with the D-165 foot (C5); clean stall 12.13 * sqrt(2.70/2.64) = 12.27 m/s <= stall_max 12.3, 1.3 Vs 15.95 <= AIRSPEED_MIN 17 (B2 to confirm); loads +2.3 % (C1 / C2 / C4 re-run). nodes.note: R8: 2.0 -> 2.5 mm rail each side of the inspection window: the 1.4 mm tine chamfer (needed by the R 2.0 sleeve fillets) costs tine section; with R8's CALC-D5-SIDE (windowed section at F (a - 3 mm), full section at F a) the tine SF is CL-D5-SIDE-TINE-SF. Window 10.7 -> 9.7 mm wide, still shows the cartridge stripe. R7 (D-76): 1.5 -> 2.0 mm

nodes.title: landing.piston.window_offset_m
nodes.note: D5-R9 (closure 2026-11-14): tine inspection window starts this far aft of the sleeve end at rest (was a fixed 3 mm). The 5 mm longer lever (41.4 -> 46.8 mm) took the windowed-section tine SF to 1.018; starting the window 10 mm aft puts F (a - 10 mm) on the windowed section: SF 1.21 (the full section at F a: 1.85). Window 30 mm long, still shows the cartridge stripe; the 6 mm replace mark sits on the solid wall ahead of it

nodes.title: landing.piston.replace_mark_m
nodes.note: D5-R9 (D-165): 3 -> 6 mm, C5's honest mark (CL-C5-MARK-HONEST-MARGIN). Scribed line all round the tine 6 mm aft of the rim, on the solid wall ahead of the inspection window (piston.window_offset_m 10 mm); once it is inside the sleeve, replace the insert. R4: 6 -> 3 mm

nodes.title: landing.piston.corner_chamfer_m
nodes.note: R8: 45 deg chamfer on the four outside corners of the tine so it clears the R 2.0 sleeve fillets with the 0.2 mm slide clearance: the chamfer ends sit sqrt((R-cs-tc)^2+(R-cs)^2) = 1.844 mm from the fillet centre, 0.156 mm inside the 2.0 mm arc (CL-D5-FILLET-CLEAR; R7 was 1.0 mm chamfer on R 1.0, 0.175 mm). With 1.0 mm the gap would be 0.030 mm

nodes.title: landing.pad.z_outer_m

The fin step gets 2 mm shallower (9.0 -> 7.0 mm, CL-D5-FIN-STEP-Z 0.201 -> 0.203); the flange overhang is unchanged. Outboard edge of the pad and flange; tip-over pivot = z_outer - edge_r. nodes.title: allowables.print_kd
nodes.source: C6 rule (C4 ASM-C4-PETG-TENSILE practice since R1)

nodes.title: allowables.petg_inplane_pa
nodes.note: 0.5 x 47 MPa. Prusament PETG TDS v1.1 (16-02-2022), 3D printed specimens, tensile yield 47 +/- 2 MPa horizontal, 50 +/- 1 MPa vertical xz (lower taken). Tension and bending with the stress in the layer plane. Was 40 MPa (D5), 25 MPa (C3)
reasons: marked UNVERIFIED in redesign/team/C6/params.json: 0.5 x 47 MPa. Prusament PETG TDS v1.1 (16-02-2022), 3D printed specimens, tensile yield 47 +/- 2 MPa horizontal, 50 +/- 1 MPa vertical xz (lower taken). Tension and bending with the stress in the layer plane. Was 40 MPa (D5), 25 MPa (C3)

nodes.title: allowables.petg_interlayer_pa

nodes.title: allowables.petg_bearing_pa
nodes.note: unchanged: 0.43 x 47 MPa, bearing on a bore wall with the layers in the bore plane, creep under bonded preload (the sheet gives no compressive value: -). C2 checks the block von Mises peak against this row

nodes.title: allowables.petg_shear_pa
nodes.note: unchanged: shear-out and web torsion in the layer plane; 0.43 x 23.5 MPa, below the von Mises ratio 0.577 (the sheet gives no shear value: -)

nodes.title: allowables.petg_e_pa
nodes.note: tensile modulus 1.5 +/- 0.1 GPa horizontal, 1.6 +/- 0.1 vertical xz (100 % infill). C3 FEA uses 1.8 GPa, D5 FEA 2.0 GPa (linear models: stress does not depend on it), C4 tail tongue 1.0 GPa at 45 % fill

nodes.title: joints.dog_w_prop_m
nodes.note: C6 closure-round ask to D3 for fin_detail.mount.key_w_m (D-164 re-run): 3.0 -> 10.0 mm, now the ARC LENGTH at the dog's mean radius 12.0 mm: annular-sector dog r 11.2-12.8 mm (r_b to r_b + ring wall), 47.7 deg centred on -x; notch 49.6 deg (0.2 mm clearance each side). At 10 deg / 14 mm on C1's D-161 loads (T_lim 22.03 N, Q 0.416 N m) the design twist is 0.406 N m; hold RF 1.61 lower bound (CALC-C6-DOG). 9 deg R1 ask was 7.0 mm box

nodes.title: joints.dog_d_prop_m

nodes.title: trn.box.external_m
nodes.note: Closure 2026-11-14 (D-165 taller foot): W (x) 0.56 -> 0.565 m. The foot tips move x 0.368 -> 0.373 (cg.foot_height_m 0.053), drawn extent 0.515 -> 0.520 m; in the 0.56 box the nose gap fell to 7.3 mm (< 10) and the antenna / collar gaps went negative. +5 mm on W restores nose gap 12.30, collar 4.30, antenna 2.30 mm, aft gap 12 mm unchanged. Length 1.25 and height 0.54 unchanged (height: CL-D7-H-MIN is the least the 0.3 m drop allows; 0.45 m is below the aircraft alone, CL-D7-H-FLOOR). Was [1.25, 0.56, 0.54] (D-134). L (y) x W (x) x H (z). Freeze only after CAR-FIT.md has two measured cars

nodes.title: trn.setup_steps_s
value: open box: pull the tails of the 2 cord lashings (slipped hitch), lift lid (pillars come with it); unfold the mat upwind, rubber up
lift aircraft by the centre section, stand it on its four feet on the mat; glance at the four replace-mark grooves
take props, pitot boom and pouch from the tray
fit 4 props, colour-matched to the motor (LH nut on the CW motors), 10 mm spanner
plug in the pitot boom, check the tubes, tip cover off
TX on (before the pack, flight card)
take a pack from the battery can, seat it at the trim mark, strap it
close the AS150U pack plug, FC boots
